tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snying gzer nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston gyi lag len gsal byed kun gsal nyin mo'i snang ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i lang tsho'i cha rdzogs pas// bde chen 'gyur ba med pa baiḍūr mthing gar chags pa'i khams// gdul dka' 'dul slad rnam bcas gar dgu'i rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul che// 'jam dpal dpa' bo ma lus rgyal ba'i ye shes de la 'dud// de yi phrin las man ngag 'jo ba'i gter// rgyud sde rgya mtsho srub pa'i rin chen nor// pad gnubs ded dpon mthu yis gangs can 'dir// rgyal mtshan lhun gyis grub pa'i rtser rngoms pa// kun mkhyen 'brug pas bdag gir mdzad pa'i tshul// bcom ldan khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston gar// skal bzang do rar rtse ba'i rgyan bzang po// thar 'dod mig la mngon dga'i dpyid 'di rtsom// 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag po'i dbang bskur zab khyad sgrub dbang lugs su bskur ba'i lag len gsal byed kyi rim pa 'god pa la/ slob dpon mtshan nyid de yi las// slob ma 'jug cing lha ngo bstan// dbang bskur ba bzhi spyi yi chings// zhes gsung pa'i dang po ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ goms pa sngon sbyangs mang thos chos rnams shes// chos nyid mnyam pa'i don rig gti mug med// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med zung 'jug tu// bla ma'i man ngag thob pa'i gdeng ldan pa'i// yon tan rdzogs pa bla ma dam par bya// zhes gsung pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa bsnyen dang sa chog dang*// sta gon dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// zhes rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ dus grangs mtshan ma rdzogs pas slar// dbang bskur sngon du kha gso bya// rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa des/ lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi bsnyen pa dus grangs mtshan ma rdzogs pa sngon du song nas/ slar yang dbang bskur gyi don du mtshams bcad de bzlas pa byed pa ni/

dbang bskur ba la nus ldan du sgrub pa'i phyir bsnyen pa kha gso ba'o// gnyis pa sa chog ni/ snang srid thams cad sems kyi rtog pa yin cing*/ gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir sa'i cho ga bya mi dgos te/ ji ltar rung ba spyad par bya'o// zhes dbang chog mu tig phreng bar bshad pas sa chog bya ma dgos pa'i lugs dang*/ de la gong ma dag slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis glang po che'i dpral ba bkas nas thal byung du byon pa lta bu'i sngags 'chang chen po rnams la dgongs kyis las dang po pas sa chog bya dgos par gsungs shing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje las rim dang*/ sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po sogs 'di skor gyi rtsa ba'i yi ge dang*/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho sogs rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi yig char bshad pa ltar phyag len la'ang mdzad pa mang bas/ 'dir yang kun mkhyen chen pos dkyil chog tu 'god par mdzad pa ste/ de la dbye na/ sa chog la ni bslang dang brtag /sa lha dbang bya chag chag 'dul// baṃ blang ba yang zhar las so// zhes gsungs pa'i dang po bslang ba la'ang*/ snang ba las bslang ba dang*/ mi snang ba las bslang ba'o// dang po ni/ snang ba yul gyi bdag por bslang*// zhes rgyal po rje rigs sogs yul de'i bdag po la rin 'jal nas bslang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ mi snang der phyin gser skyems gtong*// zhes gser skyems dang gtor ma bshams pa byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐/ gang yang sa la gnas pa dang*// sa la rgyu ba'i lha mo rnams// mchod dang gtor ma 'di longs la// sems can kun dge don du yang*// byams pa'i sems kyis gnang bar mdzod// ces gtor ma gser skyems bsngos/ phyogs 'dir ci dga' bar spyod cig /ces gnang ba byin nas mi snang bar gyur/ 'di ni stegs bu'i rgyu'i sa bslang ba ste/ rdul med srog chags spangs byas te// lho yi phyogs nas sa bslangs la// zhes 'byung ba ltar yin no// gnyis pa ni/

de nas lto 'phye brtag pa ni/ rang gi pho brang 'khor bas te// gzhogs g.yon 'og tu bcug nas ni// zla ba dag la bskor ba yin// dpyid gsum mgo ni nub tu bstan// dbyar gsum mgo byang ston gsum shar// dgun gsum lhor bstan gling phyed khyab// byang shar lho nye'i thad nas brko// yid ches min na ro lnga bsal// rin po che dang lho phyogs kyi// bkra shis sas bkang stegs bu bca'// zhes pa lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ de nas sa lha mchod pa'i phyir/ zil gnon lus dkyil bzhin du sgom// stegs bu dris byugs tshom bu bkod// mchod yon nyer spyod gtor ma bshams// mi bskyod phyag rgya sar brdab pas/ hūm̐/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seṅge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// bstan ma gser mdog mdzes pa'i lus// phyed snang 'bum phrag 'khor bcas 'thon// pri thi wi de wī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥpra ti bh+yaḥ.ar+ghaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= naiwid+ya/ shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ pra ti bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thar+khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na ba ling+ta swā hā/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar spyod cig /ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ dbang bya phur pa zla gam dbal// oṃ pad+ma kro ta kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas stegs bu'i dbus su btab/ pad+ma dbang gyur 'od dmar gyis// bar chad tshar bcad tshur 'dus thim// sa chen dbang byas sar 'dzin sbyangs// bdag nyid skad cig gis pad+ma he ru ka'i skur gyur/ phur pa dmar po dbal zla gam du yod pa thogs te/ oṃ pad+ma kro ta ma hā kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phur bu btab/ de nyid skad cig gis pad+ma dbang chen gyi skur lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus nas thim pas sa thams cad dbang du byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la 'phros pas sa dang sar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa thams cad sbyangs par gyur/ lnga pa ni/ de nas bdud rtsi lnga btab pa'i// khrag chen byugs bzhin 'di skad 'don// hūm̐/ rang byung dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga ldan pa'i// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rigs mchog bsgom pa'i phyir// bka' gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po la// dam rdzas gsang ba bdud rtsi'i chag chag 'debs// oṃ mahā rak+ta a mṛ ta maṇ+ḍal hūm̐/ chos nyid khyab gdal gyur par bsam// drug pa ni/ de nas 'dul zhing byin rlabs pa// dpon slob tshang mas zhwa dang phod// nag gyon phur bhan thogs nas su// gser skyems nas brtsams rtse gsum 'gros// bar du gang bshad 'chams kyis sgrub// ces gsungs pa ltar/ dpon slob tshang mas 'grub na dang*// gal te ma 'grub 'di yis bya// rdo rje rgyal po dbus su 'dug /rgyal thebs bzhi ni sgor 'khod la// zhes pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma rdo rje rgyal po ste/ slob dpon he ru ka'i chas su zhugs/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pas rdo rje dang dril bu thogs te 'khod pa'i mdun du/ sman raka gtor gsum mchod pa lnga sogs bshams nas/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir rdo rje rgyal thebs dang rdo rje las mkhan sogs rgyal thebs bzhi po 'khod nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ 'byung brtsegs nas bzung dzab bar byas// zhes pas/ e las e yam̐ mam̐ sum̐ keṃ ram̐ chad/ ces pa nas dzab bar las byang bzhin dang mthar/ ya mān+ta ka gsan cing dgongs su gsol// sogs kyis bshags pa grub rjes/ rgyal thebs bzhis/ slob dpon mchod bstod gsol gdab 'di// zhes phyogs bzhi'i mchod pa bshams pa/

hūm̐/ yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ gis mchod rdzas thams cad sbyangs nas/ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥbar bton nas byin gyis brlabs/ sna tshogs me tog phreng ba bcings pa ni/ nas/ ti ra sid+dhi hoḥ bar gyis mchod/ chos kyi dbyings nas go 'byed sogs bstod pa yongs rdzogs kyis bstod nas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab/ hūm̐/ kun gyi rang bzhin nyid las byung*// sems nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod// mi rtog rang bzhin ting 'dzin las// stobs chen rdo rje'i skur bzhengs la// lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*// phyag rgya chen po rdzogs par mdzod// slob dpon gyis ni lha rnams bsdus// badz+ra muḥ yum dang bcas pa'i rten brten par bcas pa thams cad bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams kyang bsdus la zil gnon chen po'i nga rgyal gyis/ rang nyid zil gnon dpal chen po'i skur gyur pa'i mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba mig 'bras hūm̐ las bskal pa'i mer 'bar bas 'jig rten 'di la kun tu brdeg par bya zhing rdo rje khro bo'i lta stangs kyis phyogs kun tu blta bas/ bshos chang ting lo rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐/ yang gsang lha yi dur khrod gzhal yas 'dir// 'du ba'i dbang ldan las byed ma gtogs pa// bar chad 'byung po su yang gnas mi rung*// de bas ma thogs myur ba nyid du song*// khro bo du ma spros pas bgegs bcom par bsam zhing hūm̐ bzhi pa dang a+ye ring sngags kyis bskrad la/ dbus su pad+ma lta bu'i gar// g.yas g.yon dbus su me tog dor// shar du thabs shes 'gros kyis phyin// gzhi bca' g.yas brkyang gis bgegs bskrad// de nas gnod sbyin 'gros kyis lhor// gzhi gca' g.yon brkyang klu 'khyil 'gros// nub tu gzhi bca' sa ga'o// rkang gcig mchod skor 'gros kyis byang*// gzhi gca' zlum po'i mtha' skor du// dpa' bo'i gar dang sgeg mo'i 'jol// rdo rje'i sgo ru gnam sa brdungs// dga' ba kha sbyor song g.yal gyi'o// zhes pa ltar dang*/

shes shing spros pa la dga' na stangs stabs drug cu rtsa gnyis kyang bya ste/ rdo rje rgyal po nyid kyis so// de nas khro bcu'i phur gdab ni/ bdag nyid zil gnon he ru kar gsal ba'i snying ga'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus phyogs bcu'i bgegs gdug pa can thams cad bkugs te/ bsrung 'khor gyi phyi rol phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur 'khod la/ phur bu bcu khro bo bcur bskyed de/ g.yas su rdo rje tho ba dang*/ g.yon du phur pa thogs nas su// dbyangs dang bcas te bgegs la btab// ces pas dang por g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang*/ g.yon pas steng phyogs hūm̐ kā ra'i phur bu blangs te/ hūm̐/ snang srid 'khor lo rtsibs bcur song*// sogs dang*/ steng du khro rgyal hūm̐ kā ra/ oṃ mahā kro dhā hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra badz+ra kī la ya a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ slob dpon gyis stangs stabs dang bcas pas steng gi bgegs la btab par mos la shar gyi shar du btab/ gdab sngags 'di 'og ma kun la rigs 'gre bas/ so so'i tshigs bcad dang sngags mthar 'di nyid sbyar shes par bya'o// de nas shar gyi rnam rgyal gyi phur bu thogs te/ shar du khro rgyal bi dzā ya/ sogs stangs stabs dang bcas snga ma bzhin du shar du btab pa sogs/ phyogs g.yas skor gyis gdab/ de nas byang shar khro rgyal gsum las rgyal// sogs kyis mtshams g.yon skor dang*/ 'og tu khro bo stobs po che// sogs kyis/ 'og gi phur bu nub kyi nub tu btab pas dbang po la sogs pa'i bgegs rnams spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar phug ste gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la phur bu rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar mi bsdu bar 'jog cing*/ de rnams kyis bgegs thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzad par bsam/

slar phur bu rnams la gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ slob dpon gyis yungs thun gyis brab pa'i phyag srol zhig kyang snang ngo*// zhes sogs kyis so tshogs las mtha'// ces pa de nas tshogs dang bsgral las lhag bsngo'i bar las byang gzhung bzhin btang*/ bdun pa baṃ len pa la/ blang*/ bsal/ dbang sdud gsum las/ dang po gang len rgyu'i baṃ ni nad dang rims kyis ma shi ba/ mgo kha byang shar rkang lho nub// ce spyang gzan la rgyu 'dra min// gzhan kun lo bzhi nas brtsams te// nyer lnga'i bar gyi skyes bud med// grir shi ba yi hal ba ste// rab yin 'bring ni phyi ba'i ro// tha ma lug sogs dud 'gro gzhan// zhes gsungs pa ltar ram/ gal te dngos su ma grub na// dkar gsum mngar gsum dang bcas pas/ sbrus pa'i mar zan la baṃ ro'i gzugs bcos pa de/ dur khrod kyi tshul du byas pa'i sgrub khang gi phyogs zhig tu bzhag pa de'o// blang ba dngos la/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// dgyes pa'i gar gyis baṃ chen blang ba'i phyir// gshin rje'i las byed thams cad pho nyar 'gyed// sogs kyis pho nya bskul mthar/ dpon slob thams cad rgyan btags/ rdo rje dril bu dang rol mo sna tshogs brdungs la/ slob dpon zil gnon chen po dang*/ slob ma gshed po bzhi la sogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ rdo rje'i 'gros rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas 'gro ste/ dpa' bo chen po'i shugs kyi 'gros// g.yas brkyang ba dang mthun pa'i 'gros// g.yon brkyang sa ga zlum po dang*// rkang gcig mchod skor la sogs pa// rdo rje'i 'gros te bdun po yin// 'dren dang bsnun dang brdegs pa dang*// ro za ba dang 'phang gis 'khyud// ri bo 'degs dang klad la bskor// ye shes dbyings su rol bar byed// 'gros bdun stangs stabs brgyad du grags// zhes pa ltar ram/ yang na rol mo dang bcas pas dur khrod dam/

gang na baṃ yod pa der phyin nas so// gnyis pa bsal ba ni/ sha za mkha' 'gro 'khrugs bsal phyir// tshil dud btang zhing rkang dung 'bud// thod rnga brdung zhing sha chen gyis// brgyan pa'i gtor ma phul nas su// hūm̐/ dur khrod rgyu zhing ti ra longs spyod ma// baṃ chen sha za khrag la hub kyis 'debs// rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro bde gshegs yum gyi 'khor// bdag dang khams gsum za byed chen mo yin// thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don bya ba'i phyir// ti ra baṃ chen 'di la longs spyod kyis// khyed dang ma sring bu mo bran dang khol// thugs kyis mnar ba ma mdzad gnyis med rol// dri dang sman gyis ro la byugs// gsum pa dbang du sdud pa ni/ bdag nyid zil gnon gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ zil gnon 'od dmar lcags kyu yis// sha za mkha' 'gro 'byung bcas kyi// snying gar btab pas dbang med 'dus// sku las khro bo me bcas spros// khams gsum gang bas de rnams gzir// drag po sngags kyis brgyal rmongs rengs// zhes pas/ rang nyid khrag 'thung zil gnon chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ dur khrod kyi sha za mkha' 'gro dang*/ 'byung po rnams kyi snying gar phog pas rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan par bsams la// dpon slob thams cad kyis a+ye myags kyi nga ro 'brug lta bur brjod/ slar yang*/ slob dpon bdag nyid zil gnon chen por gsal ba'i sku las khro bo grangs med pas khams gsum me'i 'khor lo rab tu 'khrugs pa dang bcas pas dur khrod kyi sha za mkha' 'gro mas baṃ chen gyi ro la dbang byed pa de thams cad zil gyis mnan te/ brgyal ba dang rengs pa dang*/ rmongs par byas par bsams/ thams cad dgyes pa'i gar dang ldan// hur gyis blangs nas lan gsum du// dkyil 'khor bskor nas byang du e// thal chen gyis bris steng du bzhag

/zhes pa'i e ni chos 'byung gru gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi'i byang ngos su thal chen gyis bris pa'i steng du baṃ blangs pa de dgod pa ni nub dang po'i bya ba'o// gsum pa/ lhag gnas kyi rim pa la/ dkyil 'khor rdzas bum lha dang ni// slob ma baṃ gyi sta gon ston// dang po la'ang*/ rgyal chen bka' bsgos phyi mtshams bcad// dam sri mnan cing sgo byang gdags// ma ṭaṃ bsgral dang thig tshon las// dkyil 'khor sta gon dag la 'dod// ces rnam pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed las byang bzhin sngon du 'gro bas/ sgrub khang phyi ru tho bzhi btsug /de mdun mchod dang gtor ma bshams// gnas kyi phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i sar tho bzhi ste/ pha gu lta bus mchod rten bzhi brtsegs pa'i rtser shing ring bzhi yi rtse la rgyal chen bzhi yi sku gzugs kha phyir bstan pa gzugs te/ de yang*/ shar gyi yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ rgyab logs su oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ shar phyogs dri za 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad kyi mtshams chod cig ces bri'o// lho phyogs su 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri dang be con bsnams pa'i rgyab tu/ oṃ bai rū ḍha ka ye swā hā/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i 'khor rnams dang*/ bar chad thams cad kyi mtshams chod cig ces bri/ nub phyogs su mig mi bzang sku mdog dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten bsnams pa la/ oṃ bi rū pāk+ṣa ye swā hā/ nub phyogs klu dbang 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa'i mtshams chod cig ces bri/ byang du rnam thos sras ljang gu be con dang ne'u le bsnams pa'i rgyab tu/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ye swā hā/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs rnams mtshams chod cig /ces bri'o// de rnams so so'i mdun du gtor ma dkar gtor rgyan dang ldan pa re re dang*/ mchod pa lnga bshams la/

dang po shar phyogs su song nas mchod gtor rnams bdud rtsis sbyangs nas 'di skad brjod/ oṃ swa bha was sbyangs/ bh+rūm̐/ pho brang spos ngad ldan nang hūm̐ yig las// rgyal po chen po yul srung sku mdog dkar// brjid cing rgyan gyis spras pa rgyud mangs sbreng*// dri za'i sde la dbang bsgyur 'khor gyis bskor// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐/ yul 'khor srung ni shar phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal// btsun mo sras bcas blon po gnyen 'dun dang*// mdza' bshes nang mi dmag dpung dang bcas pa// dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med bstim// gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag gi phrin las sgrubs/ oṃ mahā ra dza dhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tshā swā hā/ nyer spyod lnga bya gtor ma ni// oṃ āḥhūm̐ mahā rā dza dhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs nas ni yul 'khor srung*// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan// rdzu 'phrul che la stobs po che// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs la/ dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ zhes me tog 'thor/ de bzhin du lho la sogs pa'i phyogs gzhan du'ang rim pas song ste/ bsang sbyangs snga ma ltar la/ bh+rūm̐/ pho brang baiḍūr+ya nang hūm̐ yig las// rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes sku mdog sngo// brjid cing rgyan gyis spras pa ral gri 'phyar// grul bum sde la dbang bsgyur 'khor gyis bskor// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐/ 'phags par skyes pa lho phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal// btsun mo sras bcas blon po gnyen 'dun dang*// mdza' gshes nang mi dmag gi dpung bcas pa// dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstims/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// oṃ mahā rā dza bai rū ḍha ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ra dza bai rū ḍha ka sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ zhes pas 'bul/ lho phyogs nas ni 'phags skyes po// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan// rdzu 'phrul che la stobs po che// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs la/ dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ nub nas mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs la/ hūm̐/ pho brang rgya mtsho'i dpal nang hūm̐ yig las// rgyal po chen po lus ngan sku mdog dmar// brjid cing rgyan gyis spras pa sbrul zhags 'phen// klu dbang sde la dbang bsgyur 'khor gyis bskor// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi nub phyogs nas rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐/ sna tshogs gzugs ni nub phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal// btsun mo sras bcas blon po gnyen 'dun dang*// mdza' bshes nang mi dmag gi dpung bcas pa// dad pas spyan drangs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

dam tshig pa dang gnyis med bstim/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// oṃ mahā rā dza bi rū pak+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mahā rā dza bi rū pak+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ hūm̐ nub phyogs nas ni spyan mi bzang*// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan// rdzu 'phrul che la stobs po che// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs la dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ byang nas bsang sbyangs/ bh+rām̐/ pho brang lcang lo can nang hūm̐ yig las// rgyal po chen po rnam sras sku mdog ljang*// brjid cing rgyan gyis spras pa rgyal mtshan 'phyar// gnod sbyin sde la dbang bsgyur 'khor gyis bskor// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐/ ro gdan gnas nas byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal// btsun mo sras bcas blon po gnyen 'dun dang*// mdza' bshes nang mi dmag gi dpung bcas pa// dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// oṃ mahā rā dza bai shrā ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rā dza bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs nas ni rnam thos sras// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan// rdzu 'phrul che la stobs po che// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs la/

dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ me tog 'thor la brtan bzhugs bya/ rten de rnams rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi par bsam pa'i nang du rgyal po chen po mthu rtsal can rnams bzhugs nas mtshams kyi phrin las mdzad par bsams la sgrub pa ma grol gyi bar nangs re bzhin rgyal tho'i rtsar song la mchod bstod phrin bcol bya'o// de nas sngar bzhin khro bcu'i phyi mtshams bcad ces pa/ slar yang phur bu rnams khro bcur gsal btab la/ hūm̐/ steng du khro rgyal hūm̐ kā ra// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// tshangs pa'i 'khor tshogs mtshams chod cig /oṃ mahā kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa kun la 'gre zhing so so'i bsgyur ka shes pas/ sa bdag 'khor tshogs mtshams chod cig /oṃ mahā kro dha ma hā bā la hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa'i bar ro// gnyis pa ni/ dam sri mnan pa 'di lta bu// shog bur g.yas rta g.yon khyi dang*// mi mgo gsum can liṅga bca'// snying gar dzaḥganyis sprad dbus tri// steng g.yas mdun g.yon kha sbyor bar/ trika nan u nan/ e hur breng shaka rbad thuṃ dzaḥ snyabs pa lag ring tri dzaḥ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ rgyal po the'u rang tri dzaḥs+t+wam+bha ya nan/ oṃ sum+bha ni dam sri 'gong po bsen mo yul 'dre 'khyams po s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ lus kyi mtha' bskor/ ces dug shog la lag len bzhin du bris par/ sbyang khrus sogs spyi ltar byas nas/ khug rtags ma byung bar dgug gzhug yang yang dang*/ 'gugs sngags kho nas bkug /de nas lha dbye byas zin pa dang gshin bltab byas/ skud nag rgya gram bcings nas su// khaṃ sa yos tshig ling snying bcug /ces pas/ liṅga gshin bltab byas te skud nag gis rgya gram du dkris pa de nyid kham sa dang yos tshig gi phye ma la mi gzugs mdzub gang ba zhig byas pa'i snying gar srog gi tshul du gzhug par bya'o// de yang liṅga mgo gsum du 'bri ba dang*/

bskyed bstim ma byas gong nas byad thag gis 'ching ba sogs kyi phyag len la mi 'thad pa'i gnod byed med cing*/ rnying ma rang lugs la'ang yod pa ni mnga' ris rig 'dzin rjes mdzad pa'i tshe bdag las byang las/ bdun pa dam sri mnan pa ni/ kham sa yos tshig phye ma la// mi gzugs mdzub gang ba zhig bya// de yi snying gar gzhug pa yi// liṅga mi lus mgo gsum ni// g.yas phyogs rta la g.yon pa khyi// lus gnas srog yig g.yas g.yon dbus// sogs dang*/ de ltar bris zin ma thag /bskyed bstim sogs ma bshad par/ gshin blteb byas te skud nag gis rgya gram du bcings la/ gzugs de'i snying gar gzhug go /zhes gsungs pas shes so// brub khung nya'u bskyed bden brdar// pho nya bskul dgug bstim sri sbyangs// zhes pa sgrub khang gi phyi rol sgo drung du/ brub khung e gru gsum khru gang ba gcig brkos la/ der tshig gzugs bcug nas/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*/ sogs gser skyems/ bka' drin 'khor med kyi gzu dpang*/ e las brub khung 'di nyid gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom la sogs pas/ brub khung du nya'u bskyed nas bden pa brdar la dgug gzhug lan gsum bya/ chos kyi dbyings nas 'jam dpal he ru ka /sogs kyis pho nya bskul/ a+ye ring sham bur/ dam sri ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sogs las byang gzhung bzhin btags pas dgug /a we sha ya a zhes pas bstims nas/ sri sbyang ni/ hūm̐ dam sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod// dug gsum nyon mongs dbang du song*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyen po bshig /dkon mchog gsum gyi sku dgrar gyur// pho nya lcags kyus mi 'gugs su// ngan song gsum du 'khyams la dga'// rgyab brten dbang du mi bsdu ru// sdig pa'i grogs po gtong ma phod// phyag rgya drwa bas mi bcing du// khyod kyi lus sems sdod mi nyan// liṅga'i rten la mi bstim du// bag chags ngan par rten ma byung*// rnon po rtsang gis mi bskor du// dam sri phung sri 'gros la dga'// ye shes phur pas mi 'debs su// ngan song gnas su gzhol la dga'// shes rab ral gris mi gtub tu// gti mug mun par 'khyams par 'gyur// thun rdzas rnams kyis mi brab tu// lus sems rdul du 'gro ma nyan// dug chu khol mas mi sbyangs du// ye nas nyon mongs dug gis gzir// khro bo'i zhal du mi btab tu// gzugs phung sha khrag rul pa'i rgyu// de nas bka' la mi gdags su// phyin chad ngan song dgag par byed// ces so// de nas phur bskyed nas bzung brab rdzogs bar// zhes par phur bskyed ni/

hūm̐/ bdag ni 'jam dpal he ru ka sogs nas/ mtshon cha brdeg pa'i bar gyi thun yongs rdzogs song nas/ them 'og dong brus mnan nas su// sa chu me ni rim dgus mnan// las kyi gshin rje dag la gtad// ces pas dam sri'i rnam smin lus rten dong nang du spyi'u tshugs su mnan la/ ro g.yam stong khams bris pas kha bkab pa la/ laṃ laṃ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ zhes pas dong du sa rim pa gsum dang*/ baṃ baṃ baṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ zhes chu rim pa gsum/ raṃ raṃ raṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ zhes me rim gsum ste/ 'byung ba rim pa dgus mnan la/ las kyi gshin rje la gtad pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba rten bzhi'i rngams 'og nas// las kyi tshe bdag nag po ni// ya mtshan chen po rmad du byung*// mun nag 'thibs pa'i nang du bzhugs// g.yas pa'i lag na ri rab thogs// g.yon pa'i lag na rgya mtsho 'khrugs// zhabs kyis rlung gi 'khor lo mnan// dam nyams las kyi dam sri la// mnan pa las kyi dus la bab// sgo med lcags khang nang du chug /gshin rje rnams kyi zas su byin// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon// rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du chug /ri rab chen po'i rmang du gnon// nam yang gtong bar ma byed cig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri phung sri 'byung po rgyal bsen gson 'dre gshin 'dre thams cad mā ra ya s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ ces kha mi mngon par bkab la/ hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// sogs 'phrin las bzhin du bro brdung ngo*// de nas sgo byang gdags pa ni/ ra'i sog pa'am/ ro ras sam/ gro ga shog bu gang rung la/ gshin rje'i rgyal po sku mdog mthing nag ma he'i gdong can/ dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon pas thod dbyug 'dzin pa/ ma he'i khri la bzhugs pa gcig bris pa'i rgyab ngos thugs ka'i thad tsam nas/

oṃ badz+ra karma ya mā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ khro bo gshin rje'i gshed kyis phyi yi bar chad nang du mi gtong ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces bris pa sgrub khang gi sgo yi phyi rol gyi ya them la kha phyir bstan te btags pa'i mdun du song la mchod dang gtor ma bshams nas su// bsang sbyangs/ hūm̐/ pho brang thod pa lcags mkhar hūm̐ yig las// gshin rje'i rgyal po mthing nag ma he'i gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan thod dbyug 'khor lo bskor// dregs pa'i sde la dbang bsgyur ma he brdzis// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma rā dza ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ya ma rā dza ba ling+ta khā hi/ zhes pas/ nyer mchod gtor ma phul nas su// hūm̐/ srid pa'i lha srin 'byung po kun// khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog lags kyis// rnam par smin pa'i chos shod la// sa 'di yan la bgegs ma btang*// ya ma rā dza sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes me tog 'thor/ khro bo gshin rje'i gshed kyis sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir phyi'i bar chad nang du mi gtong ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces brjod/ nang sgor bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzugs// ces pa/ las kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdong ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgyas g.yas rgya gram g.yon dril bu 'dzin cing g.yon brkyang gi stabs can klu chen po brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa cig bris pa'i rgyab logs thugs ka'i thad du/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pas nang gi dngos grub phyir mi gtong ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces bri de nyid sgrub khang gi nang logs ngos kyi sgo yi ya them la zhal nang bstan du bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams pa bsang sbyangs/ hūm̐ las kyi khro bo sku mdog ljang*// bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya yis// rgya gram dril bu 'dzin mdzad pa// g.yon brkyang klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan/

oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar btang*/ rtsa sngags la gtor sngags btags pas/ mchod dang gtor ma phul nas su// hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal lo// tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ ces me tog 'thor/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pas nang gi dngos grub phyir mi gtong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces 'dod don gsol/ gsum pa ni/ ma ṭaṃ gi khog par cho ga bzhin du bris shing sgrub zin pa'i dkyil 'khor rnying pa rab gnas can yod na de nyid bkram pa kho nas 'thus kyis/ ma ṭaṃ bsgral chog dang thig tshon gyi las rnams gang yang mi dgos la/ gal te rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri na/ dang po ma ṭaṃ bsgral ba la sngags rnying ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub gzhung chen po tshor/ dang po ma ṭaṃ de gnas gang la dbang byed pa/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ sngon byung ji ltar btul ba/ rjes 'jug gis mnan cing 'dul thabs/ btul ba'i khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa/ btul ba'i dgos pa ste sa bcad rnam pa drug gi gzhi bzung nas/ bzhi pa dang*/ lnga pa'i skabs don chos nyid kyis 'dul ba/ rtags cho gas 'dul ba/ phyi ma la'ang ma ṭaṃ gi gzugs bca' ba/ de bsgral ba/ gnas gzhan du spar ba/ khog pa brus sbyangs pa/ mthar smon lam gdab pa sogs phyag len rgyas pa'i lugs ltar 'dir yang byas na mi rung ba ni ma yin pas de ltar byed pa'i dbang du byas na/ ma ṭaṃ gi gzugs khaṃ sa la bcos pa dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi'i dbus su bzhag /bsgral nas khog pa brus sbyangs pa sogs byas zin pa dang*/ yan lag lnga snying dang nang rol mtshan ma rnams so sor bcad nas maṇ+ḍal gyi phyogs mtshams gnas so sor bkod/ khog pa dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlab pa la dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa yin kyang*/

'dir ni phyag len bsdus pa'i lugs su de dag gi snying po tsam 'thus tshang 'khyer bde'i tshul du/ kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sgrub dkyil khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston du 'god par mdzad pa'i dgongs pa bzhin 'chad na sgo byang gdags zin pa dang*/ nang logs nas/ stegs bu khyab par rū tra'i gzugs// gdong gsum lag drug rkang bzhi bris// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mgo dang rkang lag stegs bu'i rgya khyon gyi mtha' dang mnyam zhing*/ khog pa la bzhengs rgyu'i dkyil 'khor tshud pa'i tshod tsam du/ ma traṃ ru dra'i gzugs gdong gsum lag drug rkang pa bzhi pa zhig ri mor bris la/ slob dpon 'jam dpal gshin rje'i nga rgyal dang bcas/ bden stobs pho nya bskul dang dgug /ces gsungs rnams rim bzhin 'di ltar bya ste/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= khro bo'i rgyal po 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po 'di yi byin gyi brlabs kyis/ rnam pa ma traṃ rū dra ngo bo dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang log 'dren thams cad skad cig yud cig la dmigs pa'i rten ma traṃ gi gzugs 'di la lcags kyu can rnams kyis khug cig /zhags pa can rnams kyis chings shig /lcags sgrog can rnams kyis sdoms shig dril bu can rnams kyis myos shig /lan gsum byas nas pho nya bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas 'jam dpal he ru ka sogs dang dgug pa a+ye ring sham bu 'di// ma traṃ rū dra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ma traṃ rū dra ā yur+dz+nya na ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ma traṃ rū dra tri yaṃ ni ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ma traṃ rū dra ru pa skan+dhu ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ pra be sha ya phaṭ/ hūm̐/ ma traṃ zhes brjod ru tra khyod// thub dka'i drung du dam log byas// sngon yang sgrub la bar du bcad// dngos grub kun la rab tu sgrib// de tshe 'jam dpal gshin rje yis// thugs rje thabs kyis bzung nas su// ma 'gags rol pa'i tho bas bcom// bsgral nas dur khrod rgyan du byas// khungs dang rtsad bcad bdag las byung*// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ru tra 'di// bdag med spros bral dbyings su bsgral// de ring rgyal ba'i rjes su 'jug

/oṃ mahā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ ma traṃ ru tra dzaḥ.a kar+ṣa ru tra dzaḥkha traṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ ru tra kha traṃ ma ra ya phaṭ/ ces brjod pas bsgral nas/ khog pa gzhal yas khang yan lag /dur khrod bsam nas/ zhes gsung pa ltar yid kyis mos pa bya/ gnyis pa thig tshon gyi las la/ thig gi rgyu/ rgyu ma'i nang shun nam dar skud lnga gang rung bdud rtsis bran/ zil gnon yab yum sbyor mtshams kyi// sems bstim ye shes lnga ru bsam// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i thig skud/ bhan+dha'i snod du bzhag pa bdud rtsis bran la/ slob dpon nub dang thig g.yog pa shar du 'khod de/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros slob ma la phog /sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gyi lus bsreg sbyangs/ yum be ta li'i skur gyur pa'i yab kyi gnas lngar rnam snang sogs rigs kyi yab lnga dang*/ yum gyi gnas lngar spyan ma sogs rigs kyi yum lnga gsal ba'i yab yum rnams gnyis med mnyam sbyor gyis snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can/ sbyor mtshams su lhung ba srad bu la thim pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ ye thig bla ma yab gsal bas// thugs nas ye shes lnga yi skud// 'ja' tshon 'drar thon gzungs ma ni// yum gsal bha gar thim nas slar// thugs las thon bsam thim skor bas// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma zil gnon yab kyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rnam pa ye shes kyi thig skud 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i skud pa lta bur thugs ka nas thon pa/ yum gyi bha ga nas zhugs pa slar yang de nyid kyi thugs ka nas tshur thon/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal sras zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus pa'i thugs bde ba chen po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can/ kun kyang 'od zer sna lnga pa'i tshul du de nyid la thim par bsams nas/

slob dpon dang thig g.yog pas thig skud nam mkhar 'then te/ hūm̐/ stong gsum dmigs bcas yum gyi gzhal yas su// thugs rje 'gyur med yab kyi thig btab pas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med byang chub sems// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dal ni mkha' la gsal// oṃ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes pas/ tshangs thig brgyad dang logs thig mkhar// nam mkha' thams cad gzhal yas khang*// rgyal rnams zil gnon lha tshogs bsam// de ltar tshangs thig sogs thig re gdab pa dang bstun gong gi sngags de nyid tshar re brjod/ de nas dam tshig gi thig dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la ji ltar 'debs pa'i tshul ni/ ye shes thig zer dam tshig thig /thig chen brgyad btab ran gru bzhi// tshangs gnyis rgyab mdun brgyad brgyad bsil// de 'dra cha gcig kun la bsnan// dang po phyed btab phyi ma gshag /gnyis bzhi drug pa'i mtha' gnyis bsil// bdun pa dang po brgyad gnyis bzhin// dgu phyed dbus nas cha gsum bzhi// bskor zhing gnyis kar phran gzas kyang*// phyi cha bzhi bsil gru gsum bkod// zlum nang gru gsum lte gling dgu /gru gsum bsnol rtse bar gshag rtsibs// drug thal mu ran nang bcur bgod// mda' yab sgo 'dzoms drug skor gnyis// bskyed cing der brten gcig phyin ra// gsum dbus gnyis bskor 'og nas re// glang rgyab dgu phyed dbus bre yan// gcig gnyis gsum gcig gsum zlum bskor// rtsibs steng gru dang 'obs dag gi /phyogs mtshams mu ran la drug cu// zhes gsung pa ltar/ legs par btab zin pa dang*/ sa tshon dgyed pa la tshon gyi rgyu rab rin po che sna lnga'i phye ma/ 'bring dur khrod kyi rdzas/ tha ma tshon sna lnga gang 'dzom la bya ste/ gang ltar yang*/ dang por byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ tshon lngar hūm̐/ khrag 'thung lngar bsam/ ye shes bstim/ 'od zhu rin chen phye mar song*// ces pa ltar/ tshon lnga snod so sor blug pa la/

hūm̐/ rigs lnga so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa bris la/ de nyid khrag 'thung rigs lngar bskyed/ de la ye shes dgug bstims dang*/ mchod bstod byas nas/ 'od du zhu ba rin po che'i phye mar song bar bsams la/ lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mtheb mdzub thabs shes shes pas bri/ ji ltar 'bri na/ gling nang ljang la gru gsum mthing*// zla gam dmar la 'khor lo sngo// rtsibs mchan dmar po gru chad mthing*// khyams ni phyogs mdog rtsig pa lnga// nang du thod pa lcags tshon cig /snam bu dmar po ba gam ser// mun pa nag la shar bu sngo// mda' dkar khyams dmar phyi nang gi /mu khyud thams cad lcags kha la// thod pa'i ri mos mdzes par bskor// ka ba phyogs mdog rgyan rta babs// ci mdzes dag tu bya ba yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa rdzas kyi sta gon la dbye na/ sta gon gnyis pa rten dang rgyan/ dbang dang mchod pa'i rdzas bshams la// zhes rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po la/ rten 'bri ba dang bsham pa dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyal bram rje dmangs thod tshal la// gtso rtsa gyad sprul las gshin gzugs// dzab byang phyag rgya rab gnas bya// zhes mi rigs bzhi po gang yang rung ba'i ban+dhar mtshan ldan dngos grub kyi rdzas su 'os pa la thod sku 'bri ba dang*/ de yang 'dir thod tshal zhes gsungs kyang*/ sngags rnying ma'i sgrub gzhung chen po kun la thod sku rang 'bri ba'i phyag len mang zhing*/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba'i yig cha lcags sdig mgo bo gru gsum las byung ba'i sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po las/ thod sbyor 'bru sna sman gyis bkang*// zhes dang*/ rgyab stod gnyer ma las chad pa'i chos sder/ pho thod mo thod bzang po la// lha bzo stobs ldan mkhas pa yis// rgyal la bzung ste yab yum sku// sras mchog sbyor sgrol mkha' lding bzhi// gsang mtshan gser dngul thugs kar bzhengs// zhes gsungs pa la/ 'dir yang dgongs par mngon te/

las byang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin du/ thod bzang kha sbyar rdzas la bstim// yon tan yid bzhin nor ltar bsam// zhes gsungs pas/ lag len dngos la/ mi rigs bzhi po gang yang rung ba'i pho thod mo thod de/ thod pa gnyis kyi nang du bul chu blug /nyi ma la lan kha yar bsros pas snum dag par byas/ bul gyi tshas tshon la mi sgrib pa'i phyir chu gtsang gis lan kha yar dag par bkrus la/ skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i dus/ thod pa gnyis ka'i dpral ba'i phyogs su lha'i dbu bstan nas pho thod la yab kyi sku/ mo thod la sbyor sgrol gyi yum gnyis gshib ste bzhengs pa bri/ de yang mo thod la yum bri ba ni/ pho thod kyi yab la mo thod kha sbyor ba'i tshe/ mo thod kyi sgrol yum yab kyi gzhog g.yas ngos dang*/ sbyor yum gzhog g.yon ngos su yod par byas te bris/ de dag la tshon ni zla gsang gi rgyud las tshon rtsi spyin med bzang ba yis// dur khrod ras la dpa' bo'i gzugs// zhes gsungs pas/ tshon rnams la spyin ma yin pa'i tshe'i khaṇ+ḍa dang baṃ gyi snying khrag mkhris chen sogs sbyar ba'i tshon gyis lha rnams thams cad mngon rtogs ji ltar rgyan chas phyag mtshan sogs nor 'khrul chad lhag med par bri/ byang bu gnyis la so sor gtso bo'i sngags dang phyag mtshan gzhan yang rtsa ba'i lha phyag rdor la sku gzugs dang*/ e badz+ra kro dha ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces sngags byang*/ rdo rje snying phreng gi phyag mtshan rnams byang bu gcig la bri/ gshin rje la sku dang*/ e ya ma rā dza kro dha hūm̐/ 'khor lo tsit+ta/ rus sbal sku dang*/ e ma hā be ru ka hūm̐/ mchod rten/ khyung la sku dang*/ e khroṃ ga ru ṇa hūm̐/ sbrul/ gyad gnon gyi lha la so so'i sku gzugs dang sngags/ e ka he dun ya ma rā dza hūm̐/ phyag mtshan ral gri snying phreng*/ las gshin gsum las tshe bdag la sku dang*/ oṃ ya ma du sha hūm̐/ 'khor lo be con/

srog bdag la sku dang*/ oṃ ya ma rak+sha hūm̐/ khram shing 'khor lo/ 'chi bdag la sku dang*/ oṃ ya ma yak+sha hūm̐/ be con 'khor lo ste de rnams lha rer byang bu re dang*/ de re rer so so'i sku gsung thugs rten rnams bris nas thod sku dang bcas pa la rab gnas legs par bya'o// gnyis pa rdzas bkram pa dngos ni/ hūm̐/ longs spyod grub pa'i rdzas mchog dam pa 'di// 'khor ba ma spangs lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir// bka' gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po la// dur khrod rdzas kyi longs spyod bkram par bgyi// zhes 'don bzhin du/ byang bu gnyis btags pa'i/ mda' phur dbus bzhag phyogs su phur// mtshams mda' zla gam ral gri dang*// rtsibs grur seng ldeng be con te// 'obs khang so gnyis khram shing dang*// sgo phur mu ran rtsang dmar ro// dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang ras bris gang yin kyang 'dra ste/ steng du lding khri bkod pa la thig btab pas dkyil 'khor dngos kyi lha gnas dang steng 'og ma 'dzol ba'i thad kar mig khung brus te mda' phur sogs rten rnams 'dzugs chog par bcos nas/ gtso bo'i lha gnas thams cad kyi lding khri'i steng du thod sku sman dang 'bru sna rin chen bkang ba de dang*/ phyag mtshan dang sngags byang gi byang bu gnyis btags pa'i mda' dang phur bu khrag chen gyis byugs pa bzhag /phyag rdor sogs rtsa lha bzhi'i gnas phyogs bzhir byang bu btags pa'i phur bu bzhi/ mtshams bzhir gyad gnon gyi byang bu bcas mda'/ zla gam gsum la las gshin gyi byang bu btags pa'i mi bsad kyi ral gri re rnams dang*/ rtsibs bcu gnyis kyi lo gshed dang gru chad kyi zla gshed rnams la so sor seng ldeng gi be con re/ 'obs khang so gnyis zhag gshed kyi gnas su khram shing so gnyis sgo bzhi'i khro rgyal bzhi'i gnas su phur bu bzhi/ mu ran la rtsang dmar drug bcu/ de'i phyir sngar gyi khro bcu'i phur pa rnams yod par byas te dgod/

gnyis pa rgyan bkram pa ni/ zhing chen bla re zhing sogs kyi/ rgyal mtshan sna tshogs go rmog dang*// mtshon cha rgyu ma'i drwa ba la// nang khrol kun gyi drwa phyed can// mda' dar lhab lhub phye 'phur sogs// rngam shing zhud pa'i spyan gzigs sbrel// ces pa ltar dang*// gsum pa dbang rdzas dgram pa ni/ mig dar me tog phreng ba dang*// maṇ+ḍal lha tsaka phyag mtshan dang*// dbu rgyan dar dpyangs rdo rje dril// bum pa'i dbang rdzas shar du'o// bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga// bhan+dha'i nang du bshams pa dang*// dpal gyi chas brgyad bkra shis bum// 'brang rgyas sha zas tshe dbang gi /rak+ta gtor ma tshogs 'khor lo// gsang ba'i dbang rdzas lho ru'o// rigs lnga las byung rig ma ni// bcu gcig ma nas nyer lnga'i bar// gsum pa'i rdzas nub baṃ ni byang*// gtor ma dbus la sman ni g.yas// rak+ta g.yon du mchod pa'i rdzas// ji snyed pa dang rol mo bshams// zhes pa ltar las// gzhan go sla la/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gal te dngos su ma 'byor na/ zan la bcos pa gzugs brnyan bhan+dha'i snod du bshams/ dpal gyi chas brgyad ni/ dbang dngos gzhi'i gsang dbang gi skabs su 'byung rgyu/ thod skam gyi phreng ba'i dbu rgyan tshar gsum po dang*/ mgo rlon gyi ga shal/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ khrag chen/ zhag chen/ sbrun chun/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/ zhing lpags g.yang gzhi'i sked dkris/ stag gi sham thabs/ rus rgyan te dpal chas bcu ka 'dir 'god/ bkra shis bum pa ni bum chog mu tig phreng bar/ pho mo gnyis kyi ka pā la kha sbyar ba las bya bar bshad pa bzhin yin kyang*/ 'dir dngos su mi 'byor zhing tshe bum dang stabs gcig par mdzad pas lag len la nyi zla gwa'u kha sbyor gyi tshe gal mthong rgyud bzhin du bcos pa dang*/ 'brang rgyas tshogs gzugs la sha dang gzhan yang zas sna tshogs kyis bskor ba ni 'chi ba med pa'i zhal zas sam/ tshogs kyi dbang bskur rgyu'i dbang rdzas yin/

rak+ta gtor ma zhes pa'i gtor ma dpal gtor lcags mkhar mar grags pa chos 'byung bsnol ma'i gdan can 'khor gsum dang bcas pa'o// yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes pa'i tshogs 'khor ni sgrub pa'i skabs rgyun du tshogs 'khor bya rgyu tshogs rdzas rnams yin la/ sman raka gtor gsum yang dkyil 'khor gyi mdun shar logs su 'god do// de nas byang du bzlog gtor ram zor gtor dpal gyi gtor ma chen po dngos bsham pa ni/ ru sbal khog gam sla nga'i nang*/ 'bru nag khrag sbrus bang rim lnga/ steng du bshos bu zur gsum pa// seng can zhal btod bang rim la// lha grangs mnyam pa'i bshos zur gsum// gnam sa chu la rgyu dgu'i gzugs// ngar glud khraṃ byang rtsang yungs kar/ rgyu drwa snying sha mar gyis brgyan// dpal gyi gtor ma chen por bshad// ces pa ltar ro// de nas/ bzlog bsad ma traṃ gzugs su byas/ zhes pa ma traṃ yin na ru tra thar pa nag po kho na yin mi dgos pas/ 'dir ma traṃ zhes pa/ gang la bzlog bsad bya ba'i yul dgra gzugs nya'u dang dkar byang la bris pa'i liṅga dmigs rten du 'god rgyu de la dgongs pa yin/ de yang ji ltar zhe na/ gdug pa sa yi brub khung dang*/ gdab pa'i thun dang nya'u ni// lte mgo yan lag bya rim bzhin// srid dang rnam shes srog chags bsam// snying gar nṛ bris dngos 'dra ba/ zhes pas/ dmigs rten gyi gzugs 'chos lugs dkar byang dmar byang gang yin kyang 'dra ste/ de la dgra bo'i srid chags pa'i phyir/ dang po rang du lte ba'i thad nas 'chos/ de nas mig la sogs pa nas yid kyi bar gyi rnam shes chags pa'i phyir mgo dang*/ de nas srog gi dbang po yongs su rdzogs par chags pa'i rten 'brel du yan lag bzhi po 'chos pa'i go rim ma nor ba dang*/ snying gar srog gi ngo bo nṛ bris pa gzhug par byas zin nas che ge mo rak+sha dzaḥdzaḥ dmigs rten la dgra bo'i khrag chags par bsam/

de bzhin du/ raṃ rak+sha dzaḥdzaḥ drod/ māṃ rak+sha dzaḥdzaḥ dbugs/ sha rak+sha dzaḥdzaḥ sha keṃ rak+sha dzaḥdzaḥ rus/ tsit+ta rak+sha dzaḥdzaḥ sems/ ti ra rak+sha dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum chags shing bstims pas dgra bo dngos su gyur par bsams la/ de lta bu'i dpal gtor chen po dkyil 'khor gyi byang ngos su bshams nas/ shar mchod lhor bshags nub tu bskang*// byang bzlog mtshams su nya'u bsgral/ ces pas/ mchod gtor ni sman rag gtor gsum gyi nang tshan de yin pas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun shar logs su sngar nas bkod zin la/ gzhan yang lhor bshags gtor/ nub tu bskang gtor/ byang du sgrub pa'i skabs su nub re bzhin 'phang rgyu'i zor gtor/ byang shar mtshams su thun rdzas nya'ur bcas pa'i gdab chas rnams bshams nas/ sgrub pa dngos gzhi'i skabs bsgral las kyang der bya/ gsum pa bum pa sta gon la/ rgyu bca' lha bskyed spyan drangs bstims// phyag mchod bstod pa dzab kyi las// zhes rim pa brgyad las/ dang po/ rgyu bca' ni/ gser dang dngul sogs rin chen bum// lha yi grangs sam gnyis kyi yang*// rnam par rgyal ba lha kun te// las bum bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'o// mtshan ldan legs bkrus spos kyis bdug /oṃ byang mgul btags mgul kha brgyan// lnga tshan lnga dang chu yis dgang*/ rdo rje gzugs thag btags la bkod// byang shar mtshams su stegs bcas bzhag /gu gul gyis bdug yungs bas brab/ swa bhā wās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las muṃ mthing nag /'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus thim// tri shū lar gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐ be ta li rak+sha sa masta hūm̐/ sbyor ba'i yum gyur bha gar bh+rūm̐/ de yongs gyur pas phyi bum pa// nang ni dur khrod gzhal yas khang*// chu dang 'o ma lha yi gdan// ces brjod bzhin pas de ltar bsgoms nas/ gnyis pa lha bskyed pa la/ rdzas ni/ a kro te ka zhes pa mu tig phreng bar 'byung bzhin 'dir yang bya ba la dgongs te rdzas yungs kar la dmigs nas/

bskyed sngags/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa bum par blug pa'i rkyen gyis bum nang du skad cig gis/ bcom ldan dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon sku// zhes pa nas/ bshan pa khrag skyug dregs pa kun gyis bskor// zhes pa'i bar gyi/ mngon rtogs phrin las bzhin du byas// de nas las bum sgo byang bzhin du bskyed// ces pas/ las bum khro bo sku mdog ljang*// bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya yis// rgya gram dril bu 'dzin mdzad pa// g.yon brkyang klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan// spyan drangs nas bzung dzab kyi bar// zhes pas/ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing sogs dang*/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes sems dpa' sogs/ lnga pa phyag bya ba ni/ lha yi rgyal po sogs/ drug pa mchod pa ni/ sna tshogs me tog phreng ba sogs/ sman rag gtor gsum sbyor sgrol gnyis med kyi mchod pa dang bcas pa'i 'bul tshigs yongs rdzogs dang*/ bdun pa bstod pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings nas go 'byed sogs kyis so// las thams cad pa'i lha'i bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa yi// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod// brgyad pa dzab ni gsol 'debs dang dzab bro byas la/ slob dpon gyis gzungs thag 'jus te/ sngags phreng 'od kyis bde gshegs rnams// zil gnon yab yum rnam par byon// nam mkha' gang ba'i byang sems rgyun// rang gi spyir thim snying nang nas// 'od kyi zer thag la 'jus te// bum pa'i lhar thim de yum gyi// bha ga brgyud pas bum pa gang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar yid la bsgom bzhin pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi snying po dang*/ a+ye ring bzla/ de nas gzungs thag las bum khar spos nas// 'khyil ba'i gsang gnas bdud rtsi ni// rdo rje phra mo'i rdul du byon// bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/

nyer gcig tsam bzlas pas/ bum khengs mthar ni lha rnams kyang*// bdud rtsi'i rnam pas de la thim// bum pa khengs nas mthar lha rnams kyang bdud rtsi'i rnam par zhu nas bum chu dang gnyis med ro gcig tu thim pa'i mos pa bya'o// bzhi pa lha sta gon ni/ lha yi sta gon dkyil 'khor la// dmigs pa mtshams bcad nas bzung ste// bstod pa'i bar yin dkyil 'khor lha// mngon sum lta bur bzhugs gyur nas// stobs nus phun sum tshogs par bsam// zhes pas/ rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yin gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ mtshams gcod nas bstod pa'i bar gyi las byang rdzogs par 'don pa yin te go sla/ lnga pa slob ma sta gon ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba las shes par bya'o// sta gon drug pa baṃ gyi sta gon la/ bdug bskrad khrus bsang brgyan snying thag /bkon bcug mnan bslab slob ma'i bzhin// ces pa'ang rim bzhin/ gu gul gyis bdug bgegs bskrad la// rnam bum gyis khrus las kyis bsangs// gser g.yu dar brgyan snying thag ni// dkar dmar byang sems gnyis bsam bsgril// ces pa'i khungs dga' rab rdo rje'i gzhung las/ nub gnyis pa chas su gzhug pa/ baṃ chen la gu gul gyis bdug /bgegs bskrad/ rnam rgyal bum pas khrus byas la/ las bum gyis rgyan chas rnams bsang*/ gser g.yu dang dar zab kyis brgyan/ dkyil 'khor lha la mchod bshags bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lag len la dngos su'ang bya zhing*/ de la snying thag rgyu'i skud pa dkar dmar gnyis po byang sems dkar dmar du bsam nas bsgril bzhin pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// hūm̐ nyon cig ti ra mchog chen khyod// thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// bdag gi chas su gzhug par bgyi// ngan song gsum du lhung dogs nas// snying thag dkar dmar stod du mnan// mtha' yas rlung gi me spur ro// thugs rje rgyan gyi thag pa btags// zhes so// de nas/

baṃ btags phur pas gtod la mnan// phur pa sras mchog ya ma rar// mnga' gsol// ces pas snying thag baṃ gyi snying gar btags/ sne mo phur pas gtod la mnan nas mchod pa bshams la/ phur pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ya ma smug po 'khor lo tsit+ta bsnams// drag shul che la dpal gyi chas brgyad 'chang*// g.yon brkyang 'bar ba'i dbus na brjid par 'gying*// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med ngo bor gyur// ya ma rā dza badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ smug nag 'jig rten kun gyi gshed// log lta spyod ba'i stobs kyis gnon// 'khor ba'i tsit+ta'i phreng ba bsnam// ya ma rā dzar phyag 'tshal bstod// su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs dang me tog 'thor// de nas nyi zla gza' skar tsaka /ces pa/ nyi zla gza' skar bris pa'i tsakli thogs la/ hūm̐/ lha srin sde brgyad zil gyis gnon slad du// nyi zla gza' skar bris pa mgo la bkon// zhes pas baṃ gyi mgor bskyon snying po gsum bris pa zhes pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum byar bzhugs// ho/ bstan pa'i sgron ma bcom ldan 'das// lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol// dregs pa'i stobs kyi tshul bstan pa// brtul zhugs dam pa bdag la stsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ bdun pa spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bla mas spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyod pa rnam par phye ba ni gsum ste/ bden pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa la brten pa yin no// rgyud la lar/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// skyob pa shākya seṅga yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// ces gsungs so// gsang sngags kyi spyod pa yang rnam pa bzhi ste/

bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med do// rnal 'byor bla med la'ang*/ ma hā yo ga /a nu yo ga /a ti yo ga gsum du yod pa las/ 'dir rdzogs pa chen po a ti ltar nyams su len pa 'di la yang*/ dmod pa'i las rnam pa gsum las/ drag sngags gnam thog chen po'i sbyor ba/ de la yang*/ las kyi mtha' tshe bdag /'chi bdag /srog bdag gsum las/ 'di tshe bdag /de la yang lhun gyis grub pa'i tshe bdag /phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag /phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag /sprul pa'i tshe bdag /las kyi tshe bdag dang lnga yod pa las/ 'di phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag ces bya ba yin no// zhes spro ba bskyed nas/ brgyad pa nyan par gdams pa ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed nges blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes so// dgu pa sems bskyed gnyis kyi sdom pa len pa la/ dang po thun mong ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsung thugs kyi snying po/ oṃ e ka ya ma he dun rak+ṣa dun dun dza ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ āḥ.e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ e myags ya rngubs muk+shak+ka dun hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gser la sogs pas bris la/ hūm̐/ mthu rtsal byin rlabs chen po 'byung ba'i phyir// yig 'bru snying po bris pa zhal du gzhug /ces/ khar bcug dgra ling 'og tu mnan// dgra bgegs kyi liṅga bris/ dgug bstim las byang gzhung bzhin byas la/ hūm̐/ bdud dang log 'dren ma lus tshar gcad phyir// dgra bgegs dgug bstim liṅga 'og tu gzhug /ces liṅga baṃ gyi 'og tu mnan no// gnas gsum dri thig byin rlabs sngags/ sngar bzhin brjod nas 'di skad bsgo// baṃ chen gyi gnas gsum du bdud rtsi'i thig le bkod pa dang bstun// na ma sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/

de bzhin du kā ya'i tshab la wāk+ka tsit+ta bcug pas byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐/ nyon cig ti ra baṃ chen khyod// bdud dang rtsal 'dren ma byed cig /sde brgyad ru shag ma 'gyed cig /btsan dang ru 'dren ma byed cig /rmu dang cho lo ma rtse zhig /ces brjod/ gsol gdab yol ba'i phyir drangs man// slob ma lha gnas la byed kun// baṃ la'ang bya ba shes par bya/ zhes pas/ ho/ ston pa'i sgron me bcom ldas 'das/ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa man/ slob ma sta gon la ji ltar bya ba bzhin 'dir baṃ la'ang bya ba yin no// dkyil 'khor bzhi ste rdul tshon dang*// lus dang bha ga baṃ chen po// zhes pas/ baṃ sta gon gyi zhar byung du// dkyil 'khor bzhi yi sta gon yang bya ste/ de yang*/ dkyil 'khor gsum du bsdus pa dang bzhir dbye ba'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis/ bde chen ye shes sku dang mchog gi baṃ// mtshan ldan gzungs ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du// rab 'byams bgrod pa rnam gsum la brten nas// zhes pa ltar yin la/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gsum du bsdu na'ang baṃ chen dkyil 'khor gyi grangs su 'dren pa ni/ de nyid kyis kyang gsal mod/ 'dir ni pha ma'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor bzhi ni/ dga' rab rdo rje'i gzhung las 'byung ba ltar/ thabs rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ rang lus rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzhan lus shes rab bha ga'i dkyil 'khor// rang byung ye shes chos nyid brdal khyab chen po'i dkyil 'khor te/ bzhi pa ni baṃ gyi rnam par mtshon na/ baṃ de la rtog pa skad cig kyang med/ skye mched thams cad bkra lam me snang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin yin la don rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos nyid yin pas so// zhes gsungs pa bzhin// dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi las/ de dag sta gon rim bzhin bya ba'i phyir/ dang por/ bris pa phyag rgyar bcas pa dang*// rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi sku// bdud rtsis bsangs te zhes rdul tshon nam ras la bris pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/

dbang gsum pa'i rten gyi phyag rgya'i lus dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku ste/ dkyil 'khor gsum po thun mong la dmigs nas las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ gshin rje gshed po khros pa'i me// sogs nas/ dzab kyi bar gyer tshig gcig gis bton nas/ bzlas pa gzhung bzhin byas mthar/ sku sngags phyag rgya bum cod pan// rdor dril rigs lngar bsgom byas nas// ye shes spyan drangs dbang bskur bstims// bum dbang gi rdzas de dag la dmigs te/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka mthing nag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zil gnon bud+dhā he ru ka smug nag g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma sangs rgyas spyan ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zil gnon rat+na he ru ka ser nag g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma mā ma ki dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma na bza' dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zil gnon karma he ru ka ljang nag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum rnams tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod pa phul/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas/

ye nas sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rdo rje 'chang rgyal spyi gzugs yin mod kyang*// ma rtogs sems can thugs rjes bsgral ba'i phyir// khro bo rol pa'i nus mthu'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ hūm̐ swā aṃ hāḥ.a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ dbang bskur nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ de nas dam tshig bdud rtsi la sogs rdzas// yi ge gsum gyi sbyor bas sbyangs// slob dpon yab yum zil gnon bskyed// ces pas gsang dbang gi rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'jam dpal he ru ka de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyi sku/ dug ha la ha la ltar mthing nag /dbu gsum phyug drug zhabs bzhi pa/ yan lag rags shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar la chags pa/ dbus zhal mthing la rngam pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing*/ ljags la khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa/ sma ra ag tshom smin ma skra thams cad kham ser/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzir nas bskal pa 'jig pa'i me spro ba/ khro gnyer gtsigs pa'i shangs kyi bu ga drug nas 'thor byed kyi rlung nag po 'tshubs pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub/ thod pa lnga'i cod pan dang*/ bdud dang mu stegs dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi bdag po thams cad bsgral ba'i mgo bo lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang snying spel ba'i rgyu ma'i ga sha rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ sbrul chen gyis brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko ba rlon pa stod du gsol zhing*/ zhing chen gyi sked dkris pa/ khrag dang bcas pa'i stag lpags sham thabs su byas pa/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu/ mkhur tshos dang sna la rak+ta'i thig le/ brang gi 'dzoms su zhag gi zo ris rtse gsum gyi dbyibs su bris shing*/

rdo rje'i mtshon cha ngar ma'i gshog pa brgyangs pa/ yum be ta li mthing nag snying dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang snyom par 'jug pa/ g.yon brkyang nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor zil gnon bud+dhā he ru ka yab yum/ mgrin par zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka yab yum/ thugs kar zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka yab yum/ lte bar zil gnon rat+na he ru ka yab yum/ gsang bar zil gnon karma he ru ka yab yum/ thams cad kyang g.yas pa rnams kyis rang rigs kyi phyag mtshan dang*/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum rnams tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ sa ma ya hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra e a dza li hūm̐/ bde bskyed snyoms 'jug gnas lnga yi// khro bo lnga yang bde bas brgyal// rdo rje dbus nas snying ga'i bar// bde ba'i 'od kyis 'phags pa mchod// thams cad bde chen byang sems gyur// yab gyi zhal zhugs gnas lnga'i yang*// lha zhu yum gyi sbyor mtshams bab// de las phyir 'phros 'od lnga dang*// de nyid khrag 'thung rigs lnga po// yum bcas rol bas sbyor mtshams kyi// bdud rtsi dbang rdzas rnams la thim// dbang rdzas byang sems rang bzhin gyur// mdun gyi rigs lnga de la bstims// lhag par tshe rdzas zil gnon lha// dmar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum can// thugs kar nṛ la a+ye ring gsum// drag bzlas 'od kyis snod bcud bzhus// tshe lhar 'dus pa tshe yi lhas// nṛ la dbang bskur bh+rūm̐ gyis bsrung*// hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i drwa mig bstims// zhes gsungs pa'i dmigs pa rnams sgom bzhin du// a+ye a+ye a+ye ya ma nṛ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes ci nus bzla'o// de nas pad+ma rak+ta'i chos 'byung steng*// mtshan ldan gzungs ma khrus byas 'dug /dri bzang lus dang bha gar byug

/sbyor ba'i yum du sgom du bcug /de yi bha ga gsang ba'i gnas// dkyil 'khor chen por rdzogs par gsal// spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag bya mchod// bstod pa'i bar du legs par bya// zhes pa ste/ 'dir yang dga' rab rdo rje'i gzhung las/ nam tho rangs dkyil 'khor chen po'i nub tu pad+ma rak+ta'i chos 'byung e yi pho brang gru gsum bkod/ de la mtshan dang ldan pa'i gzungs ma gu gul gyis bdug /chus khrus byas/ dri bzang gi chu lus dang bha gar byug /sbyor ba'i yum rdo rje khros mar sgom du bcug /ces 'byung ba'i don te/ lag len dngos la/ gzungs ma dngos sam rig tsaka dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu pad+ma rak+ta'i chos 'byung gi steng du bkod pa sogs ji ltar bshad pa bzhin byas nas/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las muṃ mthing nag /'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus thim// tri shū lar gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐// be ta li rak+ṣa sa masta hūm̐/ rig ma sbyor yum be ta li mthing nag /snying bzung khrag gi mtsho rngubs gzigs sham can// sku ni gtum sbeg dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// ral pa mun gtib rngam pa'i gar gyis rol// de yi bha gar bh+rūm̐ yig yongs gyur las// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs mchod rten dbyibs// sogs nas bstod pa rdzogs kyi bar las byang gzhung bzhin gtang*/ de nas/ bshags bya slob dpon bdag 'jug bya/ bshags pa byas la/ baṃ dang slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i don du/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug rgyas par blangs/ de nas baṃ la 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba bzhin/ tshe dbang ma gtogs pa'i dbang yongs rdzogs slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin du bskur nas/ snying gar bdud rtsi 'thor zhing thig le bkod de/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ gyi phung po khams skye mched thams cad lhar dag pa'i snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bskyed pa'i phyir/ dang por de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/

hūm̐/ skye med rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang nas/ sogs las byang gzhung gi mngon rtogs la 'jug cing*/ spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag mchod bstod pa dzab kyi bar du btang nas/ lhag par a+ye ring dzab kyi dus// nam mkhar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma// thams cad sprin phung 'khrigs 'drar tshogs// dgyes pa'i gar dang bzhad pa'i glus// baṃ la me tog char 'bebs shing*// shis brjod mnga' gsol mdzad par bsam// dngos su rol sgra spos dud sbyar// ces gsungs pa ltar nan tan du sgom la/ sku gsung thugs sngags dang*/ gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sngags bsgrangs/ khyad par a+ye ring ci nus bzlas/ de nas tshogs bshams nas bzung ste/ gdab pa'i bar du bya ba ste/ zhes pa/ tshogs dang gdab las yongs rdzogs las byang ltar bya/ de ni dgongs brgyud nag po rin po che'i rgyud las/ baṃ gyi tsit+ta'i pho brang du// tshe bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rtag /phung po khams dang skye mched la// ya ma'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par rtag ces pa'i dgongs pa/ slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes/ ti ra baṃ chen de la/ dbang rnams tshe dbang ma gtogs pa bskur/ de yang*/ yang yang bskur ram/ thengs gcig bskur yang rung ste/ don shin tu che'o// zhes dang*/ de ltar dbang rdzogs pa dang*/ baṃ chen de'i snying gar bdud rtsi gtor/ dri bzang gi thig le bkod de/ bcom ldan 'das tshe bdag nag po'i dkyil 'khor bskyed/ yan lag dang skye mched lha'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te/ ti ra de ni ye shes lha'i rang bzhin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ dkyil 'khor bskyed de rtog pa gang yang med pa'i phyir ro// ye shes kyi rtsal cir yang ma 'gags par snang ba ste rgyu yi thabs bzhin no// 'di yi dus na bar snang thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis khengs nas/ bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs dang*/ dgyes pa'i gar du ma mdzad cing*/

baṃ la me tog mthor zhing bkra shis brjod par bsgom la/ thams cad kyis rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ gsur chen spos dkar la sogs dud pas btul lo// zhes 'byung ba'i don no// 'on kyang de nyid las/ de nas nub gsum pa la/ dbang bskur ba ni gnyis/ baṃ la dbang bskur zhing dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba dngos so// zhes baṃ la dkyil 'khor bskyed cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba gnyis ka nub gsum pa la yod dgos rgyu gsungs pa ni/ sa sta gon dang bcas pa'i dbang kha rkyang la dgongs/ 'dir ni/ gnyis pa bsnyen dang sa chog dang*// sta gon dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// zhes dang*/ sgrub pa chen po dag la ni/ nas/ rtags dang bstun nas sgrub ces pas/ dbang sgrub sbrags nas byed pa'i sgrub dbang gi lugs su mdzad pa'i khyad par du shes par bya ste/ de dag ni nyin gnyis pa'i bya ba'o// bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la/ sgrub pa chen po dag la ni// rdo rje slob dpon dzab gyi dus// rdo rje rgyal thebs pas phrin las// bstod pa'i bar yang rdzogs par bya// slob dpon gyis ni sgrub rdzas kyi// gzungs thag der gtad bshags dang tshogs// rgyal thebs pas ni dzab nyid de// de bzhin rin chen pad+ma dang*// las kyi rgyal thebs rim pas bskor// zla ba gcig gam lo dag gi /gang 'dod rtags dang bstun nas sgrub// ces pas bla ma rdo rje rgyal po dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khod pa'i mos pa'i phyogs ci bder bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar du rdo rje rgyal thebs/ lhor rin chen rgyal thebs/ nub tu pad+ma rgyal thebs/ byang du las kyi rgyal thebs rnams 'khod la/ nyin re bzhin thun drug gam/ bzhi'am/ gnyis su dkyil 'khor bdag mdun bum pa sogs mtha' dag la dmigs te/ dpon slob chabs cig pas skyabs sems nas bzung dzab kyi bar thog mar las byang tshar gcig bton/

de nas brtsam ste sngags rgyun ma chad par rgyal thebs rnams kyis las byang 'don pa'i dus su/ rdo rje slob dpon pas dzab kho na bzla/ de nas slob dpon gyis tshogs dang bsgral las la sogs pa'i dus/ gzungs thag rdo rje rgyal thebs par gtad de// des sngags bsgrang*/ de bzhin rin chen pad+ma las kyi rgyal thebs la'ang bskor te/ nyin mtshan kun tu bzla/ sngags rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir thun res su bskor/ nyin re bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi lho nas tshogs mchod 'bul zhing bshags pa bya/ nub tu gu gul sha chen gyi gsur dud sbyar zhing*/ zhun chen gyi mar me dang bcas pa'i bskang ba dam rdzas baṃ bskang 'don/ nub re bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi byang du bkod pa'i thun gtor bzlog bsgyur gyi tshig 'don pa dang bcas pas 'phang*/ byang shar mtshams su nya'u bsgral ba rnams ma chag par bya/ de lta bu'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i yun tshad gang 'dod rtags dang bstun te/ rab 'khor tshom bu dang bcas pa tshe la dbang ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin gyi gnas su 'gro zhing*/ lam lnga tshe 'di nyid la rdzogs nas dngos grub chen pos bdag gzhan gyi re 'dod skong nus pa'i 'bras bu ma thob kyi bar dang*/ 'bring ni rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa lnga dang thun mong gi grub chen brgyad dang rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin ma thob kyi bar ro// tha ma yang 'jig rten du bde ba dang legs pa du ma 'byung zhing zhi sogs kyi las la dbang ba dang skye ba brgyud nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas thob ste/ rim pas lam gyi lhag ma sbyangs nas mi ring bar bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal khro bo'i go 'phang thob 'gyur gyi bar de srid du'o// yang na bod yul 'dir deng sang phyag len du mdzad bzhin pa'i sgrub chen gyi 'dra 'bag mos slob tsam la ni/ zhag lnga'am bdun sogs ji tsam 'dod pa bya'o// bdag 'jug kyang nyin bzhin grub na legs/

gal te ma 'grub na'ang slob mar dbang bskur gyi gong der nges par dgos so// de nas slob ma 'jug pa'i phyir/ bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hūm̐/ lhun grub rang bzhin gnas pa'i pho brang nas// ye shes rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub pa'i rtsal// 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed kyi lha// ma lus gnas pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol// slob ma mtshan ldan yum gyi dbang dal du// brtul zhugs drag po'i stobs kyis bzhugs su gsol// bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang dam pa ru// rig pa'i brtul zhugs stobs kyis bzhugs su gsol/ lan gsum dkyil 'khor lha la gsol/ slob ma sta gon ni/ de nas yol bas de bcad la/ khrus bskrad gsol drangs phyag bya gsol// spro bskyed nyan gdams sems gnyis sdom// sgrib bsal byin rlabs so shing dang*// khyor chu ku sha bsrung chos bshad// rmi lam brtag pa slob ma'i 'o// yol ba btang bas/ dkyil 'khor chen po slob mas mi mthong bar byas la/ dang po khrus bya ba ni/ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs par bzhugs// rdo rje las mkhan chas zhugs nas// phyir phyin slob ma ji snyed pa// khrus byas ces gsungs pa ltar/ sgrub khang gi 'gag tu/ sgo ba'i chas su zhugs pa bsdad/ rdo rje las mkhan chas zhugs bgyis bzhin pas las bum thogs te/ phyi rol du phyin nas slob ma gcig gam du ma yang rung ste/ ji snyed par khrus bya/ gnyis pa bskrad pa ni/ bgegs gtor byin brlabs byin// ces pas/ bgegs gtor yang de nyid du bshams la 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐/ yang gsang lha yi dur khrod gzhal yas 'dir/ zhes sogs brjod cing gu gul bdug /thun brab a+ye ring hūm̐ bzhi sogs brjod pas bskrad la/ hūm̐/ gshin rje gshed po khros pa'i me/ sogs me dang*/ steng yang mtshon cha'i bla re la// sogs mtshon cha 'chol ba dang*/ dpa' bo bdud dgra 'dud 'dul phyir// sogs khro bo 'chol ba dang*/

chos dbyings rnam dag skye ba med pa'i dbyings// sogs kyis gsang mtshams bcad pa ste/ mtshams bcad bzhi po byas la/ gsum pa gsol gdab ni/ de rjes sgo ba la/ hūm̐/ ma shes 'khor bar 'khyams bsgral te// theg pa chen por 'god pa'i phyir// dpa' bo chen po dpa' byad can// ye shes sgo 'di bdag la phye// zhes gsol ba btab/ bzhi pa drangs pa ni/ sgo bas phye nas las mkhan gyis// rdo rje la bzung chig sbreng khrid// ces las mkhan gyi lag tu rdo rje bzung bzhin pas 'di skad brjod/ hūm̐/ 'bras bu rdo rje gsang ba'i lam// 'di ni theg chen bla na med// gzungs phreng rdo rje 'di la 'jus// thar ba'i lam mchog 'di la shog /slob ma rnams kyis kyang de'i lag gi rdo rje 'jus te nang du 'ong ba yol ba'i rtsar bzhag /lnga pa phyag bya ba ni/ gus 'dud dang bcas pas phyag lan gsum byas te/ mdun du 'khod bzhin pas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ drug pa rdo rje slob dpon la gsol ba gdab sogs kyis so// thun mong ma yin pa ni/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po dang*// rang byin brlabs pa'i thabs shes la brten nas// bde bar gshegs pa'i dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems bzung ngo*// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ā drā u pa da ya mi/ zhes pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'di yis blang*// rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pas// rtag tu brten cing spyad par bya// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtang ngo*// gsol gdab 'di gsum ka lan gsum gsum bya// bcu pa sgrib pa bsal ba ni/ yig brgya lan 'gas slob ma'i sgrib// sbyangs nas zhes pas/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ ya mān+ta ka twe no pa sogs slob dpon dang slob ma chabs cig pas lan gsum mam lnga bdun sogs gang rung brjod pa'o// bcu gcig pa byin rlabs pa ni/ zil gnon bskyed la ces pas/

slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong*/ phyogs skyong ma he brdzis pa'i gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar rgyu dang rkyen med par/ khyed rang rnams phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'jam dpal he ru ka sogs nas/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur bar gyis bskyed la/ gnas gsum dri yi thig le byas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin wāk+ka tsit+ta bcug /spyi mgrin snying ga'i gnas gsum so sor dri thig re dang sngags re sbrags nas bya'o// bcu gnyis pa so shing 'dor ba ni/ tshom bu lnga pa'i maṇ+ḍal te// me tog phreng bcings so shing gi /rtsa ba so ma drud pas so// zhes pa ste/ mdun du so shing 'dor ba'i tshom bu lnga bkod nas/ 'di nyid rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du shes pas/ de la dngos grub kyi pra brtags pa'i phyir so shing 'dor ba zhu sogs kyis brda' sprad nas/ so shing rnams slob dpon gyi phyag tu 'dzin zhing las chus bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ bdun phrag tsam bzlas sam bgrangs zin pa dang*/ slob ma la sprad nas/ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes 'don pas 'dor bcug /de yang rtse mo dbus su zug na mchog /shar lho nub byang zhi rgyas dbang*// drag po mtshams ni thun mong ba// steng 'og mkha' spyod sa spyod 'grub// ces brda' sprad/ bcu gsum pa khyor chu blud pa ni/ de nas dri chu khyor bar blug /ces pas/ dang po de nyid las chus bsangs/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā sarba pā pā ni tsa s+yaḥbi shwa dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ lan bdun bzlas pa sbyin/ slob mas hub gsum lhag ma rgyab tu dor/ bcu bzhi pa ku sha gtad pa ni/ ku sha bsang*/ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa baṃ/ lan bdun bzlas pa'i sngas dang stan du byin/ bco lnga pa bsrung skud ni/

skud pa sogs dmar lus tshad pa// sum bsgril rdo rje'i mdud sum brtsegs// de nyid las chus bsangs/ a+ye myags la hūm̐ phaṭa/ btags pa nyer gcig bzlas pa'i phus btab nas/ skyes pa'i g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su byin la/ slar yang mdud mtshams su dri yi thig le dang rdo rje rgya gram bzhag /a+ye myags ya rngubs muka shak+ka dun/ ces brjod pas bsrung nas/ bcu drug pa chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gi sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// zhes so// bcu bdun pa rmi lam brtag pa ni/ bzhin bzang dag /bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo ston la dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhu ba la mos gus chen pos nyol la/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bzang ngan rmi lam du ston cig /ces bya dkyil 'khor gang der nyal/ de ni slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba'o// gsum la slob ma 'jug pa la dbye na/ 'jug pa de bstan dbab dang sprod/ dang po la/ 'jug pa phyi nang phyi la yang*// khrus bskrad gsol drangs phyag bya gsol// spro bskyed nyan gdams sems gnyis sdom// sta gon ji bzhin 'dir yang ngo*// zhes pas de rnams nyin snga ma bzhin du bya ba yin la/ 'on kyang khrus bskrad phyi rol du bya ba dang*/ sgo ba gsol ba gdab pa sogs/ dngos su ma bde na slob dpon mdun rang du byas kyang chog /gang ltar/ bo dhi tsit+ta a dra u pa da ya mi/ zhes byang chub sems gnyis kyi sdom pa bzung ba'i rjes zlos lan gsum pa'i mtha' bar sta gon bzhin la/ ston pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das/ sogs gsol gdab kyi mgor maṇ+ḍal 'bul dus bla ma dang 'jam dpal zil gnon chen po dbyer ma mchis pa'i drung du/

dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug cing dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhu ba'i yon du/ zhes 'don pa tsam gyi khyad par ro// nang 'jug gdong g.yogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol drangs dri dang khas blangs so// sngar dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba mtshon phyir/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings la/ 'jug yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐/ yang gsang gshed po'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags kyis// rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso// dpa' bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ ces lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis ni rdo rje gtad/ rim bzhin nang du drangs pa'i dus/ hūm̐/ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus kun// rgyu lam lnga yi sgo bcad de// mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phyes nas// bla med gnas su drangs bar bya/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod/ dngos su slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la slob ma rnams lag pa reg tu gzhug /de nas rdo rje mgo bor bzhag nas/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// gsang ba'i dam tshig bsrung nus sam// sgrub mchog brtul zhugs spyod nus sam// mngon spyod las rnams byed nus sam// lan gsum bar dri slob mas kyang*// rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// khyod kyis bka' stsal bdag rjes sgrub// dam tshig sdom pa gang yin dang*// gsang ba'i las kun sgrub par 'tshal// brtul zhugs chen po bla med pa// mthar lam phyin pa spyod par 'tshal// phrin las rnam bzhi'i bya ba rnams// ji ltar gsungs pa nyan par 'tshal// zhes pas khas blang bya ba yin// de nas gnyis pa lha ngo bstan pa la// dgongs gsol sgo dbye phyag lha bstan/ slob ma'i rgyud ni byin brlab pa// zhes rnam pa lnga las/ dang po/ slob dpon gyis ni dkyil 'khor lhar// lha dang rdo rje slob dpon mched// phyogs mtshams kun nas mkhyen pa'i dpal// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// lan gsum/

zhes brjod sgo phye 'di yis so// ho/ ye shes rnam pa kun ldan cing*// dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang*// yul las 'das pa'i ye shes kyis// mkha' dbyings dag pa'i shar sgo phye// zhes brjod pa dang bstun nas slob dpon gyis sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya/ sor mo g.yas g.yon bsnol ba'i rtse mo rang la bstan pa de 'grol ba dang sbrags/ shar sgo phye zhes pa'i skabs su dbye tshul rnam cha dod par byed pa dang*/ yang na srin lag mthe'u chung gnyis bkug pa'i rtse mo'i phyi ngos nas mthe bong bkug pas mnan/ mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis brkyang bas dbye tshul byed pa ste/ gnyis ka sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya yin pas ci bder bya'o// zhes pas dkyil 'khor chen po yi// phyogs shar sgo ni shag gis phye// slob ma dkyil 'khor shar sgor zhugs// zhes gsungs pa ltar yid kyis mos pa bya/ mnyam nyid dag pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag lan gsum 'tshal du bcug nas 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa yab yum rtsa ba'i lha bzhi/ gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa las gshin yab yum drug /lo gshed pho mo nyer bzhi/ zla gshed bcu gnyis/ sbas pa'i ma bzhi/ zhag gshed so gnyis/ sgo ba gshed chen bzhi/ yum ro langs ma bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje bka' nyan ji snyed pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa zhal mngon sum du khra hram mer bzhugs pa rnams la mos gus dung pa gyis shig /'di ni slob ma'i rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug phyir mos gus bya bar bskul nas gang la bya ba'i yul dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams don spyi'i tshul du bstan pa yin kyang lha ngo sprad pa dngos ma yin pas zlos par mi 'gyur ba shes dgos so// zhes bstan byin rlabs 'di yin no// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal zil gnon chen po'i mdzod spu'i dbus nas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa na ra ra byung khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams su zhugs/

lus la thim pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus kyi sgrib pa thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa ltar bsregs/ mgul gyi dbus nas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa na rar byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ ngag la thim pas ngag sgrib dag /thugs ka'i dbus nas 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa na ra ra byung*/ snying ga nas zhugs yid la thim /yid kyi sgrib pa dag pa'i mos pa gyis/ de nas lho sgor phyin nas/ sngar bzhin sgo phye phyag byas lha/ byin rlabs spro bsdu zhes pas lho sgo nas kyang*/ ho/ ye shes rnam pa kun ldan sogs kyis sgo phye ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ lha bstan pa/ byin rlabs bsdu ba rnams sngar ltar dang*/ de bzhin nub/ byang la'ang rig pa bsgres te shes par bya'o// de nas byin dbab pa ni/ dbab la dam gnyis maṇ+ḍal gsol// bskyed dgug bstim sngags me tog dor// brtag dang lha bstim dag tu bshad// ces pa'i dang po/ mna' chu byin nas 'di skad brjod/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ oṃ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha dzaḥhūm̐ ṭha ṭha i dan+na ra kan/ rak+sha sogs kyi phreng ba bkon la/ slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu mchog rdo rje khyod// de ring phan chad nga yi bu// nga yi bsgo bar bya ba dang*// dam tshig la yang gnas par gyis/ zhes brjod// slob mas/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du// maṇ+ḍal phul nas gus pas su// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// chos dbyings ye shes pho brang nas// ye shes khro bo'i sprin chen po// ma lus bdag la dbab tu gsol// ces lan gsum gyis/ gsol ba gdab/ bum pa'i mgul gyi oṃ byang rnams/ slob ma'i mgor bzhag 'di skad brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'jam dpa' phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i thugs ka nas/ yi ge ā+oṃ re khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon pa'i mos pa gyis/
