hūm̐/ thig le'i ngo bo 'jam dpal sku// chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// na ro rdo rje sems dpa'i sku// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// zla tshes pad+ma dbang gi sku// kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// ha ni don yod grub pa'i sku// bya ba nan tan ngo bo nyid// a ni sangs rgyas bde gshegs sku// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// yig 'bru lnga yis byin brlabs pas// sku lnga ye shes ldan par shog /ces pas/ slob ma ji tsam yod kyi mgor oṃ byang re bkod la/ oṃ de 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la zhugs pas/ lus mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu dang rkyen med par khyed rang rnams phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'jam dpal he ru ka de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi spyi/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyi gzugs kyi sku/ dug ha la ha la ltar mthing nag /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ yan lag rag shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar la chags pa/ dbus zhal mthing la rngam pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing*/ ljags la khrag gi rgya mtsho'i rba klong 'khrugs pa/ sma ra ag tshom smin ma skra thams cad kham ser/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzir nas bskal pa 'jig pa'i me spro ba/ khro gnyer bcings pa'i shangs kyi bu ga drug nas 'thor byed kyi rlung nag po 'tshubs pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub/ thod pa lnga'i cod pan dang*/ bdud dang mu stegs dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi bdag po thams cad bsgral ba'i mgo bo lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang snying spel ba'i rgyu ma'i ga sha /rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko ba rlon pa stod du gsol zhing*/ zhing chen gyis sked dkris pa/ khrag dang bcas pa'i stag lpags sham thabs su byas pa/

dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu/ mkhur tshos dang sna la rak+ta'i thig le byas pa/ brang gi 'dzoms su zhag gi zo ris rtse gsum gyi dbyibs su bris shing*/ rdo rje'i mtshon cha ngar ma'i gshog pa brkyang ba/ g.yon brkyang nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ spyi bor de bzhin gshegs pa'i khro bo bya khyung dkar po/ rdo rje'i rwa dang mchu sder/ nyi zla'i mig /mtshon cha mi bzad pa'i spu gshog can/ sbrul chen po bzung nas khar za ba/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus su/ sku yi khro bo ya ma rā tsa smug nag 'khor lo dang be con can/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su// gsung gi khro bo rta mchog rol pa/ dmar nag rdo rje zhags pa can/ snying gar rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i dbus su/ thugs kyi khro bo phyag rdor ljang nag /rdo rje snying phreng can/ lte bar rin po che cha brgyad pa'i dbus su/ yon tan gyi khro bo rus sbal rngam pa mi zan dmar ser/ mche sder gnam lcags las grub cing*/ khrag gi thig le dug gi sme ba/ yan lag drug la mchod rten gyis mtshan pa/ snying gar lha srin gyi srog 'chang zhing*/ lto ba srid pa'i khyams khang du snang ba/ gsang gnas su rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbus su/ phrin las kyi khro bo rdo rje phur pa mthing nag dbu gsum/ phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ phyag drug rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga me dpung kha ṭāṃ ga tha ma gnyis kyis phur bu bsgril ba/ khro bo thams cad dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan pa'o// phrag gong gnyis su khyung mo smug nag /nu kha gnyis su sed+ge dkar mo ral pa sprugs pa/ sog gzhung gnyis su stag mo mi ro za ba/ sta zur gnyis su sbrul nag kha nas dug rlangs 'gyed pa/ g.yon du sbyor yum be ta li mthing nag snying dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dbyings yum mu kha li dmar smug khram shing dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa/

g.yas su sgrol yum e ka dza ṭi sngo skya ral gri dang g.yu spyang 'dzin pa/ khro mo dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ rtsibs steng la phyi nang gsang ba lo zla zhag /dus bzhi za ma'i gshed pho mo thams cad/ gdug pa can gyi mtshon cha bzung zhing drag shul chen po'i sku/ glang po che'i go zu gyon zhing*/ ha ha dang hi hi'i sgra sgrog cing rngam pa'i 'chams kyis rol pa'o// de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar sa bon yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag /de las dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od zer bla ma'i thugs kar phog /bla ma'i thugs ka nas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ chos kyi dbyings drag po e yi gzhal yas khang nas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa yab yum/ rtsa ba'i lha bzhi/ gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa las gshin yab yum drug /lo gshed pho mo nyer bzhi/ zla gshed bcu gnyis/ sbas pa'i ma bzhi/ zhag gshed so gnyis/ sgo ba gshed chen bzhi/ yum ro langs ma bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje/ bka' nyan ji snyed pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snying gar lcags kyu'i dzaḥ zhags pa'i hūm̐/ lcags sgrog gi baṃ/ dril bu'i hoḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar char babs pa bzhin du byon la/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi sngags kyi mthar dz+nyā na a bā+e sha ya āḥzhes pa btags pa drag tu bzla/ spos kyis bdug cing rol mo bsgrags/ ces pas/ skabs 'dir rol chen re nges par byed/ spros med kyi skabs kyang spos btul/ slob dpon gyis ḍā dril bya/ gar dang brda skad 'phar sogs 'byung*/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag /de nas dkyil 'khor drung khrid la// ces pas me tog dor te/

de yang gang la 'dor na/ dkyil 'khor dngos ras bris lta bu yin na de nyid du dang*/ gal te rdul tshon yin tshe lha mtshan zub par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa 'byung ba 'gog pa'i phyir steng nas ma reg par dar la sing lta bu phyi nang mi sgrib pa zhig bkab pa la me tog dor bas lha'i mtshan ma mi sub cing gang la phog pa ngos zin pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ rig bzo'i lag len lta bu yin kyang don la mi 'gal bas 'thad cing legs pa yin/ yang na dkyil 'khor la mi 'dor na'ang*/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gzhan zhig la 'dor ba'i lugs kyang yod do// de min stegs bu'i maṇ+ḍal la lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod lcogs na dang*/ gzhan maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad la 'bru'i tshom bu'am rigs lnga'i mtshan ma'am/ bum mtshan nam/ rigs brtag cing gsang mtshan 'dogs pa la phan pas lha tshogs kyi gtso bo lnga'am dgu'i phyag mtshan sogs gang rung bkod pa yin/ de yang shar phyogs la sogs pa'i rjes 'breng*/ mtshams shar lho sogs rim pas yin phyir/ mtshams rnams su mtshan ma ma bkod kyang*/ phyogs rnams su rigs su 'thus pas/ phyogs bzhi lte ba dang bcas pa bkod/ gzhan la ma bkod na lnga dang*/ mtshams rnams su'ang bkod pas dgur 'gyur ba yin/ de la gal te dgur byed pa spro na/ rigs lnga'i mtshan ma 'god tshe shar dang shar lho rdo rje nas/ byang dang byang shar ral gri'i bar du dang*/ lha tshogs kyi gtso bo gtso bo'i phyag mtshan bkod na/ lte bar 'jam dpal zil gnon gyi phyag mtshan 'khor lo/ shar du phyag rdor gyi rdo rje/ lhor gshin rje'i 'khor lo/ nub tu rusbal la mchod rten/ byang du bya khyung la sbrul rnams dang*/ mtshams rnams su gyad gnon phyag mtshan ral gri 'ba' zhig 'god pa yin kyang phal cher snga ma bzhin legs/ yum rnams la me tog phog kyang rigs ngos 'dzin rgyu dang*/ ming 'dogs rgyu logs su med pas/ yum gsum gyi phyag mtshan dgod mi dgos/

dus 'khor las ni rnam rgyal bum pa'i khar/ maṇ+ḍal la bum mtshan dgu bkod nas 'dor bar yang gsung mod/ 'dir mi mdzad do// de rnams gang la yin kyang 'dra ste/ dkyil 'khor dngos las/ gzhan la dor phyin 'dor ba'i lha mtshan de rnams la dmigs nas/ lha so so'i mtshan tsam slob dpon gyis brjod pas/ slob mar skad cig gis gsal 'debs su bcug pas/ dam tshig par mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha de dang*/ de'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba re chad de byon pa'i ye shes pa bsre ba'am/ yang na thog ma nas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i ngo bor gsal btab la/ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ lha yi rgyal po lha mchog sogs/ bstod pa gang rung shwa lo kas bstod/ a+ye thung brgya phrag nas bdun gyi bar gang rung bzlas nas/ de la me tog dor ba'i las zin pa dang*/ lha de rnams mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar bsdu/ rgya gar ba'i phyag len gyi rjes 'brang bod 'dir mkhas mchog 'ga' zhig gis mdzad pa 'dir yang rung zhing*/ nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin pas ci bder byas la/ hūm̐/ bde chen rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe las 'phro yod pa'i lha// gang yin mchog la dbab par shog /zhes dmod bor nas/ e ka ya ma mu dra traṃ puṣ+pe sa ma ya pu dza hoḥzhes sam/ slob ma mang por bskur dus sngags ring ba ma lcogs na puṣ+pe sa ma ya pu dza hoḥ zhes kho nas kyang chog te/ gtso bor dmigs nas me tog dor/ rang rigs kyi lha ma brjed par zungs shig /ces gdams/ gtso bo mchog la 'khor thun mong*// me tog blangs te spyi bor bzhag /phog pa'i lha de'i sngags brjod nas// de nyid lus la thim par sgoms// zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ gtso bo la gtso sngags// phyag rdor la phyag rdor ky-i sngags nas/ mtshams rnams su gyad gnon gyi sngags kyi bar 'don bzhin spyi bor 'chings rgyu yin kyang*/

phal cher bshad tshod bzhin mi bde bas ma 'grub na/ e thung rang bgrangs kyang chog pa yin no// mig dbye gsol dbye lha ngo sprad// ces pa'i dang po slob mas/ shin tu ma rig mun pa yis// bdag nyid long bar gyur pa las// 'jam dpal thugs rje chen po yis// bdag gi mig 'di dbye ru gsol// oṃ badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa/ ces pas/ gsol btab mig thur thogs nas su// ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib 'jam dpal bdag gis bsal/ tsak+ṣu pra we shaka /ces bla mas brjod la/ slob ma rnams kyi gdong g.yogs bsal/ de nas lha ngo sprad pa ni/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyi// rtsol ba'i sems stobs las byung ba// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// gzhan la gsang ba ma smra zhig /ces pas bskul nas/ slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor la bltar bcug ste/ dbyug pa'am/ ku sha'am/ rdo rje'i rtse mos brda' mtshon par byas te/ de yang mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs 'di na/ gzhi chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i mkha' dbyings chos kyi 'byung gnas/ khyab gdal yangs pa chen po'i klong du 'byung brtsegs ri rab pad+ma dur khrod rdo ra me ri bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rang rig rang shar rang byung rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yang khang*/ rgya khyon tshad bzung med pa/ phyi bltas kun tu bzang po'i rgyan bkod pa'i gzhal med kyi khang chen po/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs mchod rten gyi dbyibs can/ khyung gi tog mdzes pa nang bltas dur khrod kyi khang pa 'jigs su rung ba/ sgo rnams stag gzig /ya them 'brug dang*/ ma them glang chen 'gram gnyis sed+ge byas pa/ nyi zla'i rgya skar can/ rus sbal gyi ka gdan/ lha chen po brgyad kyi ka ba/

gza'i zhu/ klu'i gdung ma/ tshangs pa'i lcam/ zhing gi thog phub pa/ chu srin gyi bad skor/ rgyu skar drwa mig can/ nya sbrul gyi za ra tshag /rtsig 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bur mchod pa'i lha mo mang po mchod rdzas kyi sprin spro ba dang bcas te gar byed pa/ dbus ling tse dgur bcad pa'i phyi ma drag pa e gru gsum gyi pho brang*/ zla gam gsum/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis/ rtsibs kha gru chad bzhi dang bcas pa/ khyams 'obs spel ma so gnyis/ mu ran drug cu te/ kun la thod pa lcags kyi mkhar gru gsum pa can gyi nang dbus su/ klu 'bum gnyan khri/ sa bdag stong*/ lha chen phyogs skyong ma he la sogs pas btegs pa'i khri la/ 'khor lo rtsibs stong pad+ma zla nyi brtsegs pa'i steng du/ phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'jam dpal he ru ka de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyi gzugs kyi sku/ dug ha la ha la ltar mthing nag /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ yan lag rags shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar la chags pa/ dbus zhal mthil la rngam pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing ljags la khrag gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa/ sma ra ag tshog smin ma skra thams cad kham ser/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzir nas/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i me spro ba/ khro gnyer bcings ba'i shangs kyi bu ga drug nas 'thor byed kyi rlung nag po 'tshubs pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na/ 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub/ thod pa lnga yi cod pan dang*/ bdud dang mu stegs dang srid pa gsum gyi bdag po thams cad bsgral ba'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang snying spel ba'i rgyu ma'i ga sha rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko ba rlon pa stod du gsol zhing*/ zhing chen gyis sked dkris pa/

khrag dang bcas pa'i stag lpags sham thabs su byas pa/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu/ mkhur tshos dang sna la rak+ta'i thig le/ brang gi 'joms su zhag gi zo ris rtse gsum gyi dbyibs su bris shing*/ rdo rje mtshon cha ngar ma'i gshog pa brgyangs pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus na gar dgu'i nyams dang bcas te bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon logs su sbyor yum be ta li mthing nag snying bzung khrag gi mtsho rngubs gzig sham can/ g.yas su sgrol yum e ka dza ṭi sngo skya ral gri g.yu spyang 'dzin par re lde'i smad g.yog can/ g.yon du dbyings yum mu kha li dmar smug khram 'debs nad rkyal ba glang gi ko ba dkris pa/ ling tshe'i phyogs mtshams rnams su phyogs skyong pho mo'i gdan la rim bzhin/ shar du phyag rdor ljang nag rdo rje dang snying phreng 'dzin pa/ lhor ya ma smug nag 'khor lo tsit+ta bsnams pa/ nub tu rus sbal rngam pa mi zan dmar ser mche sder gnam lcags las grub cing lto ba srid pa'i khyams khang du snang ba/ byang du bya khyung dkar po gshog pa me mtshon dang mchu sder rwa rnams lcags las grub pa gzi mig can sbrul bzung nas za ba/ me srin rlung dbang bzhir/ sed+ge stag sbrul khyung gdong gshed bzhi rang 'dra'i yum dang bcas shing rus sbal gyi g.yang gzhi gsol nas ce spyang la zhon te/ ral gri dang snying bzung ba/ zla gam gsum gyi mkhar nang du klu gnyan sa bdag gi khrir rim bzhin/ tshe bdag rtsa zhal gsum dkar dmar mthing khro/ bar gyi zhal gsum stag gzig dom gyi gdong*// steng zhal gsum po khyung zhal te/ dbu dgu pa sku mdog nag po/ phyag bco brgyad kyi g.yas pa dgu'i 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje rtse gsum mdung mda' dbyug rgya gram lcags kyu/ g.yon pa dgus be con gtun shing zhags pa sbrul sdigs mdzub spu gri dgra s+t+wa g.yang gzhi tsit+ta gsol ba/

dbyings phyug rgyal mo dang rol zhing zhabs brgyad bsgrad pa/ 'chi bdag nag po chu srin gyi gdong can gdengs ka dgu g.yo ba/ smad sbrul mjug dang rus sbal gyi gos can/ be con 'khor lo bzung nas yum dug hrul ma dang brtse ba/ srog bdag dmar po mgo bcu pa'i steng ma bya rog gi zhal dang gzhan khro bo bse khrab gyon pa/ khram shing dang 'khor lo 'dzin pas yum khrag 'jibs ma la rol ba/ rtsibs rnams la ya ma rā dza mthing nag yum khrag mdog ma/ myos byed 'bar ba ser po yum gsod byed ma/ ār+ya dmar po yum srog len nag mo/ ral pa tshar dgu ljang ga yum ral gcig ma/ dung gi mon pa sed+ge'i mgo can yum bla rkun ma/ lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo can yum g.yu yi ral can ma/ bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo can yum khrag ral can ma/ gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo can yum snying 'byin mon mo/ he le khyab pa nag po yum mi zan ma/ nag po 'dzum med yum snying khrag dug 'thung ma/ so bdar 'khrigs pa nag po yum sha la gzer 'debs ma/ ral pa spyir bcings yum bdud mo khrag ral ma/ gru bzhi'i steng dang bar dang 'og khang rnams la/ sgo logs g.yon ngos nas brtsam rim bzhin/ be wa sa ta/ nor bu dge 'phel/ 'joms byed ser nag yum phung byed re ma ti/ dgu khri nag po/ rak+sha glog phreng dmar po/ yak+sha gsod byed mthing nag yum tsā muṇ+ḍi/ gtum po dang kun 'joms gnyis sku mdog dkar po/ 'bar ma ti sngon po yum ral gcig dmar mo/ sbrul mgo kun 'dzin sngon po/ ngang pa stobs ldan ser po/ gyad pa stobs ldan nag po yum 'bar ma ste/ zla gshed 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ phung byed sbas pa'i ma mo bzhi dang bcas pa/ khyams 'obs su shar na bdud nag khram thogs rta zhon brgyad/ lhor gshin rje be con dang 'khor lo thogs pa glang zhon brgyad/ nub tu ma mo nad rkyal zor thogs drel zhon brgyad/ byang du gnon sbyin ral gri zhags pa thogs pa bya zhon brgyad/

sgo bzhir dkar po snying 'byin/ ma hā ka la/ yab rje nag po/ gnod sbyin dmar po ste dus bzhi'i bdag po khro rgyal bzhi/ yum chen ro langs chen mo bzhi dang bcas pa/ phyi khyams gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu/ za gshed pho mo drug cu/ phyi yi dur khrod na/ rgyal chen phyogs skyong*/ bstan ma mkha' 'gro/ las byed kyi bshan pa/ mi bsrun dregs pa'i sde tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa ste/ mdor na dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum gsal rdzogs su mjal byung snyam pa'i dga' spro dung dung ba mdzod cig /de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnam par dag pa ji ltar dran par bya'o// zhes pa yang*/ 'di lta ste/ gzhal yas khang ni phyi snod 'jig rten rnam par dag pa dang*/ dbus kyi gru gsum mthing nag ni yum gyi mkha' chos dbyings spros bral mtshon pa'o// zla gam gsum ni rnam par dag pa'i bde ba chen po/ thod phreng ni thugs rje'i rol pa/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis dang lcags mkhar bcu gnyis ni skye mched bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa'o// gru bzhi tshad med pa bzhi/ khyams phrin las bzhi/ sgo bzhi ye shes bzhi/ rta babs rnam par thar pa brgyad/ drwa ba drwa phyed phar phyin bcu/ rgyan sna tshogs pa chos brgyad kyi spros pa rnam par dag pa/ rtse mo mtho ba thig le nyag gcig /dregs pa can gyi gdan rnams ni de dag bsgral nas chos nyid sbyor ba/ nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan ni thabs dang shes rab dang ma chags pa mtshon pa'o// nang bcud kyi sems can rnam par dag pa ni/ brten pa lha yi 'khor lo ste/ dbus kyi gco bo bcom ldan 'das ni 'byung ba nam mkha'i khams dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo ste/ de yang sku mdog mthing ga ni/ 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen po/ dbu gsum ni gzhi khams gsum gyi 'gro bar zhen pa'i bdag 'dzin gsum/ lam rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum du dag nas 'bras bu sku gsum du grol ba'i don no// phyag drug ni gzhi rigs drug tu 'khor ba nyid/

lam phar phyin drug tu dag nas/ 'bras bu rigs drug gi ye shes chen po drug tu grol ba'o// zhabs bzhi ni bsdu ba bzhi mtshon pa'am/ sbyang gzhi skye ba rnam bzhir 'dzin pa nyid/ lam tshad med pa bzhir dag nas/ 'bras bu rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhir grol ba'o// khro bo'i chas rnams ni/ rgyan du chags par 'dzin pa ma spangs ye shes su dag nas/ 'bras bu mtshan dang dpe byad du grol ba'o// rang 'od rdo rje'i me phung ni ma rig pa'i mun pa rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i ye shes su dag nas 'bras bu ye shes chen po'i klong du rang grol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so// yum gsum ni/ dngos por 'dzin pa dang*/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang*/ smon par 'dzin pa gsum kyi dgrar stong pa nyid kyi ye shes rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yum gsum du snang ba'o// phyag rdor ni 'byung ba sa khams dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa/ 'bras bu me long lta bu'i ye shes su grol ba rdo rje'i rigs/ ya ma rā dza ni 'byung ba me khams dang tshor phung mnyam nyid ye shes su dag pa rin po che'i rigs/ rusbal ni 'byung ba chu khams dang*/ 'du shes kyi phung po sor rtog ye shes su grol ba pad+ma'i rigs/ bya khyung ni 'byung ba rlung khams dang 'du byed kyi phung po bya grub ye shes su dag pa las kyi rigs/ sprul pa gshed bzhi ni/ nyon mongs pa bzhi lhar dag pa'i ye shes bzhi'o// las gshin rgyal po gsum ni/ nyon mongs dug gsum sku gsung thugs su dag pa'i ye shes/ lo gshed bzhi ni/ ye shes bzhi yi rang mdangs/ mon bdud bzhi ni/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad ye shes su dag pa'i cho 'phrul lo// zla gshed 'chi bdag bcu gnyis ni/ skye mched bcu gnyis dag pa'i ye shes/ khyams 'obs kyi za gshed so gnyis ni/ sems byung gi rgyu ba de dang de/ 'bras bu ye shes su rnam par dag pa/ sgo ba bzhi mtha' bzhi'i spros pa bral ba'i zung 'jug

/mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa bla na med pa'o// de thams cad kyang ngo bo chos nyid spros pa dang bral bas na ka dag rang bzhin nam rnam pa ni rang byung gi ye shes las phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor/ rten brten pa dang bcas par rang shar bas lhun grub/ de yang don bla na med pa'i sa la lhun gyis rdzogs pa dang*/ rtags kyis gdug pa can bsgral bar bstan pa ste/ yang dag pa na don rtags gnyis su med pa'o// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa nyid sbyor ba sna tshogs su ma 'gag par spyod pa ni thugs rje chen po ste/ hril gyis dril na/ ya gi 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po nas/ ma gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dur khrod la gnas pa'i 'byung po'i bar/ rten dang bcas pa gzhi ma bcos pa de kho na nyid chos sku 'gyur ba med par gcig /sku mtshan ma'i gzugs su snang ba kun ni/ sgyu ma lhun grub ye shes longs spyod rdzogs par gcig /las sna tshogs so so nas 'dul ba ni sprul pa'i skur gcig ste/ de ltar sku gsum gyi rol pa rang rang gi don la spyod pa ni chos nyid la chos nyid rol/ ye shes la ye shes rol/ sprul pa la sprul pa rol pa ste/ rgyud las kyang*/ ngo bo ma bcos chos kyi sku/ chos sku 'gyur ba med par gcig /sku dang mtshan mar brtag pa kun// ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// las dang sbyor ba sna tshogs kun// sgyu ma lhun grub sprul pas 'dul// rol pa'i phyag rgya snang ba'o// zhes brjod/ ces pa lha ngo sprad pa'am/ rgyas 'dod phyag rgya gsal sgron bzhin// zhes gsungs pa ni/ spros pa bsdus pa la dga' na dkyil chog bzhin la/ rgyas par mos tshe phyag rgya gsal sgron las btus te gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar bya'o// de yang lha ngo sprod pa 'di la/ lha tshogs mas nas yas rim du ngo sprad pa'i lugs gcig kyang bshad mod/ sgrub dkyil du gsal kha ma byung yang 'di ltar gsang ba baṃ chen gyi zab gter las/

dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na phyag rgya zil gnon bzhugs bya ba nas/ byang sgo'i bar du lha rnams bstan to// zhes gsungs pa ltar bkod pa yin no// bzhi pa dbang bskur ba ni/ bum dbang phyi la gsang dbang nang*/ sher dbang gsang dang baṃ chen dbang*/ bla med dbang la'o// zhes rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po bum pa la/ bum cod rdor dril ming lha drug /ces rim pa drug go /de las dang po'i don du/ phyag byas maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol zhes pas/ phyag 'tshal te/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul skabs/ bla ma sku rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang zhing*/ sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa bum pa'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi zhes bton nas/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos byar gzhug /hūm̐/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa dang*// srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang*// stong gsum yum du bsgrub pa'i phyir// dus gsum sangs rgyas dbang bskur stsol// 'jam dpal gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// bsnyen sgrub las la sbyar ba dang*// dkyil 'khor las mtha' bstan pa'i phyir// phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsol// gshed bzhi'i sbyor ba 'khor lo dang*// ban dgra gsod dang bsgral ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i phyir// mthu rtsal dbang bskur stsal du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ hūm̐/ rin chen dngul gyi bum pa ni// byang chub sems kyi chu yis bkang*// byang chub chu yis khrus byas pas/ nyon mongs bag chags byang gyur cig /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ khrus byas sdig sgrib dag par bsam// zhes pas chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags brjod bzhin pas las bum gyi chu 'thung du gzhug /khrus bya ba dngos su ma grub na/ ku shas las bum gyi chu lus la gtor/ mgo bor bzhag mi dgos/ de ltar sbyangs pa'i rkyen gyis/ stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam/

stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams zil gnon rat+na he ru ka ser nag /g.yas thod dbyugs g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma mā ma ki tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa'i mos pa gyis byas/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐/ ngo bo mnyam nyid ye shes las// rang bzhin yon tan lha ru gsal// rnam pa bum chus dbang bskur bas// rin chen rigs kyi dbang thob shog oṃ e ka ya ma rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la/ bum pa chu dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ nga rgyal rnam par dag nas rin po che'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par gyur cig /khyed rang rnams zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag /g.yas pad+ma g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma na bza' dkar mo tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma/

khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i cod pan dar dpyangs kyi 'phur ma dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i mos pa gyis byas/ cod pan thogs la/ hūm̐/ ngo bo sor rtog ye shes las// rang bzhin gsung gi lha ru gsal// rnam pa cod pan dbang bskur bas// pad+ma rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la/ cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas 'dod chags rnam par dag nas pad+ma rigs kyi dbang dang ldan te/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /khyed rang rnams zil gnon karma he ru ka ljang nag g.yas ral gri g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma dam tshig sgrol ma tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i sbyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis dril bu sgra dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i mos pa gyis byas/ dril bu thogs la/ hūm̐/ ngo bo bya grub ye shes las// rang bzhin phrin las lha ru gsal/ rnam pa dril bus dbang bskur bas// las kyi rigs kyi dbang thob shog

/oṃ e ka ya ma karma a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la/ dril bu sgra dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas phrag dog rnam par dag /las kyi rigs kyi dbang dang ldan te bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /khyed rang rnams zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka mthing nag g.yas rdo rje g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum rdo rje khros ma nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rdo rje gsor ba dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i mos pa gyis byas/ rdo rje thogs la/ hūm̐/ ngo bo me long ye shes las// rang bzhin thugs kyi lha ru gsal// rnam pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// rdo rje'i rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la rdo rje gsor ba dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas zhe sdang rnam par dag nas/ rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te/ me long lta bu'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /khyed rang rnams zil gnon bud+dhā he ru ka smug nag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma sangs rgyas spyan ma tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/

g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐/ de la 'od zer 'phros/ sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis ming 'di bya bar 'bod pa dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i mos pa gyis byas/ hūm̐/ ngo bo chos dbyings ye shes las// rang bzhin sku yi lha ru gsal// rnam pa ming gi dbang bskur bas// chos dbyings ye shes thob par shog /oṃ e ka ya ma bud+dhā a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ skabs 'dir rdo rje slob ma rnams la gsang mtshan 'bod dgos te/ de yang sngar me tog gang la phog pa yin dris te/ de dang bstun pa'i ming 'dogs tshul rnying ma rang lugs la rdo rje thod phreng rtsal sogs rigs lnga dang*/ mi 'gyur/ lhun grub/ mi ldog /yang dag /dri med/ grub pa rnams la rtsal gyi mtha' can du byed pa sogs kyang 'dug cing*/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha yi mtshan las dras nas btags kyang legs pa yin te/ de yang dper na/ me tog shar la phog na/ rdo rje mi 'gyur rtsal/ rdo rje grub pa rtsal gyi bar dang*/ bud med la lho nub tu me tog phog na/ rin chen myu gu dang*/ pad+ma myu gu zhes kyang 'dogs pa'i srol snang*/ gzhan chags pa rdo rje dang*/ gti mug rdo rje sogs kyang don la mi 'gal bas 'dogs rung tsam du ma zad/ bshad tshod kyang de ka yin mod kyi/ rnam pa mi snyan pas deng sang de ltar 'dogs pa nyung ba yin la/ skabs 'dir ni dbus su phog pa'i rigs la 'jam dpal/ zil gnon/

snang mdzad/ rnam snang sogs sbyor/ rigs lnga char la/ bzhad pa/ dga' ba/ dgyes pa sogs kyang sbyar na legs pas de ltar btags par bya'o// rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la ming 'bod pa dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ gti mug rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes thob par gyuracig /de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur dus kyi dbang rdzas rnams/ da lta rdo rje slob dpon rang gis gtod cing bskur ba shas che mod/ dmigs pa gsal ba sogs kyi dgos pas/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs par bzhugs// bum sogs rdo rje rgyal thebs pas// brim par bya zhes mkhas pas bshad// ces gsungs pa yin no// skyes pa bud med rim pas ni// ming yang khrag 'thung yab yum ste// me tog gang babs de gdags so// zhes pa ni sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro// rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la/ phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i sgo nas he ru ka lnga'i dbang bskur ba las/ nyon mongs lnga gnas su dag rig pa ye shes lnga'i dbang thob pas/ phung po lnga khrag 'thung rigs lngar gnas 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// ye shes lha dbang dag la ni// sku gsung thugs su shes par bya// de yi dang po sku yi dbang la/ gtso bo lus dkyil bzhin du bsgom/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ āḥdharma hri tu swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ ka nas dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes kun tu snang ba'i rtsal/ gnyis su med cing dbyer mi phyed pa'i thugs rje'i 'phro 'du/ e las klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong*/ phyogs skyong ma he brdzis pa'i gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar khyed rang rnams/ phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'jam dpal he ru ka sogs nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur bar du a+ye ṛng bsnyen pa'i man ngag bzhin bsgoms nas/

gzhan rnams 'di bzhin brjod pa ste/ 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma bzhi gtso bo'i lha bzhi/ 'byung ba'i snyigs ma bzhi gyad gnon gyi lha bzhi/ dug gsum las gshin gsum/ nyon mongs pa bzhi gsang ba'i gshed bzhi/ rnam shes brgyad mon pa bzhi dang bdud bzhi/ sems byung gi rgyu ba zhag dang za gshed/ gnas skabs bzhi'i thig le sgo ba bzhi la sogs pa/ lus gdod ma nas phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po grub pa'i phyir/ ye nas yin pa la yin par mos par gyis shig /pho brang nang na dkyil 'khor lha tshogs khra lam mer bzhugs pa rnams las/ rang 'dra ba re chad de/ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas/ dregs pa sku yi dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis shig /gtso bo'i tsakli mgo bzhag /phrin las bstod pa'i phyag 'tshal ba// dbang bskur ro zhes sbyar bas bskur/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas go 'byed gzugs phung dgrar// phyag rgya zil gnon mun pa chen po'i sku// rngam pa'i dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad// bde gshegs khro bo'i tshogs rje'i dbang bskur ro// e ka kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥṣ+ṭi a pa ye hūṃ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pas so// yum dang rtsa dang gyad las gshin// gshed dang mon bdud zhag dang sgo// zhes pa ni/ phrin las bstod pa kha bsgyur gtso bo'i rigs bsgres he/ stong nyid ye shes dngos 'dzin ma mo'i dgrar// sbyor yum sgrol yum dbyings yum gtum pa'i gzugs// dur khrod chas brgyan khams gsum dbang du sdud// gsang ba'i yum chen rnams kyi dbang skur ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dza e be tā lī kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ ai ma ma e ka dzā ṭi hūm̐/ e de ma kha la baṃ ril ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūm̐ a bhiṣiñca maṃ/ ye shes bzhi ni 'byung bzhi phung bzhi'i dgrar// sras mchog ya ma rā dza phyag rdor dang*// rus sbal rngam pa mi zan gdug pa'i khyung*// rigs bzhi'i khro rgyal rnams kyi dbang bskur ro/

e badz+ra kro dha ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐/ e ya ma rā dza kro dha hūm̐/ e ma hā bhi ru ka ye hūm̐/ e khroṃ ga ru ṇa hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ sprul pa bzhi ni sde brgyad dregs pa'i dgrar// sed+ge stag chen sbrul nag khyung smug po// rang 'dra'i yum bcas drag shul chen po'i gzugs// gyad gnon yab yum rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// e ka he dun ya ma rā dzā hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ sku gsung thugs ni nyon mongs dug gi dgrar// 'chi bdag srog bdag tshe bdag bdud kyi bdud// yum bcas mi sdug dgur brdzu mtshon chas gsod// las gshin rgyal po gsum gyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya ma du sha hūm̐/ oṃ ya ma rak+sha hūm̐/ oṃ ya ma yak+sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ ye shes rang mdangs srid gsum srog gi dgrar// ya ma rā dza myos byed 'bar ba dang*// ār+ya ma ru ral pa tshar dgu ste// srin mo yum dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur ro// ya ma rā dza sa do me yaḥya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe yaḥ yak+ṣe rā tsa ni ra ma yaḥ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ yang sprul rnam par shes pa brgyad kyi dgrar// rngams pa'i mon pa pho mo bzhi bzhi dang*// rab 'jig bdud bzhi bdud mo nag mo bzhi// lo gshed pho mo rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// tsaṇ+ḍa ru tra man+to dzaḥ ya ma man+to dzaḥ rak+sha man+to dzaḥ yak+sha man+to dzaḥ ru tri ru lu ha hā ya/ du ru ya ma snying du ya/ ru tra bha ti ru sha ya/ tu ru yak+sha trig+na ya/ a bhi ṣiñcaṃ*/ nying sprul gling bzhi 'gro ba yongs kyi dgrar// ma rungs las byed 'chi bdag bcu gnyis po// phung byed sbas pa'i ma mo bzhi 'khyud pa// zla ba'i gshed chen rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// e ya ma rā dzaḥkro ne kro ne/ pa kra pa kra/ shu la shu la/ dha sha gri ba/ yak+sha gri ba/ ru lu ru lu/ ha ha/ ya ya/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ sprul pa'i pho nya nyams pa rnams kyi dgrar// bdud dang gshin rje ma mo gnod sbyin tshogs// gtum po gzhan gyis mi thub gyad 'dra ba// za ma'i gshed chen so gnyis dbang bskur ro// ru dra ha la nag po// ya ma du na rak+sha ya/

ru ru tsa pa la/ kha la rak+mo thun bh+yo/ yak+sha ti nan baṃ bh+yo/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ chos skyong che rnams bdud dang mu stegs dgrar// dkar po snying 'byin nag po chen po dang*// yab rje nag po gnod sbyin dmar por sprul// sgo ba yab yum brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro// tri tsa pa la a shu me ya/ ma hā kā la ya/ ru dra du ru ya/ rak+sha ru lu ha ha ya/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ lhag ma thams cad gcig tu bya/ zhes pa ni/ gzhan yang bshan pa gtum po 'jig rten dgrar// gshed chen drug cu ma ra khrag skyugs te// dregs pa sum cu brtan ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dpal gyi 'khor tshogs rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// ya ma ya ma/ du na du na/ shaṃ shuṃ/ ghṛ ṇa ghṛ ṇa ghṛ ṇa/ pa tsa pa tsa/ be ra be ra/ ha la ha la/ hū la ya hū la ya/ ma ma ru ru/ na ga he de tri ta/ nṛ la dun bh+yo/ dun bh+yo ya/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ rgyas 'dod re res bskur ba yin/ slob ma nyung zhing lcogs na/ mu tig phreng ba sogs nas len 'os pa blangs bas sam/ tsakli'i rgyab byang bzhin lha re dang bskur tshig shwa lo ka re/ tsakli re rnams sbrags nas bskur ba yin/ dpral bar rdo rje'i dri thig bya/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar pos rgyas btab pa'i mos pa gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dregs pa sku yi dbang thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dur khrod kyi dkyil 'khor/ g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can thams cad khrag 'thung chen po'i lha tshogs su shes par gyis shig /de nas gsung gi dbang ni 'di lta bu/ slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la bskor bzhin du/ dzab bskul gyi tshigs bcad snga phyi rnams dang*/ 'bru brgyad sngags kyi dzab dbyangs dang bcas pa dngos su 'am/ gal te ma grub na mos pas kyang rung ste/ sngon tshe bsod nams bsags pa yis// bla med theg mchog 'di dang mjal// bde chen ngang nas sku bzhengs la// phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba yi// sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po mchog

/'bru brgyad sngags kyi bro chen brdungs// zhes bskul thams cad brgyan pas bzhengs// dkyil 'khor mtha' la bskor bzhin du// brjid pa dpa' bo'i bro chen dang*// dgyes pa dpa' mo'i glu dbyangs bstun/ e myags ya rngubs mug shaka ka dun/ hūm̐/ dang po'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir// skye dang 'chi ba bya ba med// 'khor ba ye nas sangs rgyas te// ngan song gsum po lta bas bsgral// rnam rtog gdod nas chos sku yin// snang srid ma bcos phyag rgya'i zhing*// thams cad dregs pa'i lha tshogs la// 'bru brgyad sngags kyi mchod pa 'bul// thams cad grags stong ye shes te// gsung gi dngos grub chen po stsol// 'di ni ye shes chen po'i bro// 'khor 'das gnyis su med par brdungs// phyag rgya zil gnon mchog gi lam// lam 'di kun gyis thob gyur cig /ces brjod dus su dkyil 'khor lha'i// thugs las drag sngags char pa babs// bdag gi ngag thim bsam nas 'jug /khyed rang rnams kyi snying gyen du kha phyogs pa'i snying tshil zla gdan/ snying rin po che zur brgyad pa'i nang du hūm̐ mthing nag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon las thugs kyi sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer mgal me 'khor ba lta bu thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi kha nas song snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du hram mer 'dug pas rdo tshan la snum mi chags pa bzhin du yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs ba'i mos pa gyis/ a+ye myags ya rngubs muka shak+ka dun hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i rjes zlos tshar gsum byed du bcug pas/ thugs kyi sngags ni lan gsum byin/ ljags kyi rtse mo nas gsung gi sngags me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad sbyangs ba'i mos pa gyis/ sa bon hūm̐ gi tshab tu āḥbakod nas/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsung gi sngags ni lan gsum byin/

sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ sku'i sngags 'ja' tshon lta bu 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus gyi bu ga thams cad nas zhugs/ lus kyi sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad sbyangs shing dag par mos/ sa bon oṃ yig bsam la/ oṃ e ka ya ma he dun rak+sha dun dun dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sku'i sngags ni lan gsum byin/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ slob dpon gyi gnas thams cad nas sngags phreng la la dkar po zhi bar byed pa'i nus pa can mgal me 'khor ba lta bu/ la la ser po sgro yi chun po lta bu/ rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa can/ la la dmar po lcag sgrog 'khyil ba lta bu dbang du byed pa'i nus pa can/ la la nag po me'i tsha tsha lta bu drag po dgra bgegs bsgral bar byed pa'i nus pa can/ sprin las char ltar du thon pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang ro gcig tu gyur pas/ drag sngags kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis/ a+yai ring a+yai thung lan gsum gsum/ de nas rdo rjes mgrin par thig /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca āḥmagrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa la āḥdamar pos rgyas btab/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis drag po sngags kyi dbang thob pa yin pas/ ngag gi brjod pa thams cad sngags kyi sgrar shes par gyis shig /slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kar zug /thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad phyag rgya dang mtshan ma'i rnam par char bzhin du babs pa khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ slob ma'i lag g.yas la phyag mtshan gtad/ hūm̐/ 'khor ba sgrol byed 'khor lo dang*// nyon mongs gcod byed ral gri dang*// chos nyid mtshon pa'i rdo rje yis// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog /e ka ya ma tsakra khat+ga badz+ra ya hoḥ g.yon par gtad cing 'di skad do// hūm̐/

be con dug lnga ye shes sgrol// gtun shing dgra bgegs 'dul bar byed// sdig mdzub bag chags bsdig pa ste// rigs pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog /e ka ya ma bhi sa hūm̐ ti ra hoḥ snying gar rdo rjes dri thig bya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon pos rgyas btab/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dregs pa thugs kyi dbang thob pa yin pas/ yid rgyu ba thams cad chos nyid la chos nyid rol ba yin par shes par gyis shig /de ltar dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyi/ dkyil 'khor du khyed rang rnams kyi yul snang lus la bum pa'i cho ga drug gis dbang bskur bas bum pa'i dbang thob/ byed pa lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam khyer bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob/ sku'i phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// gnyis pa gsang dbang la/ byang sems rak+ta gtor ma chas// tshe tshogs drug gi gsang ba'i dbang*// zhes pa rnams las dang po/ slob ma'i gdong g.yogs maṇ+ḍal phul// ces pas/ bla ma gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs shing*/ gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ 'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas// dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /gsang ba'i sgrol ma bdag la stsol// bla ma yab yum bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag yab yum du gsal ba'i gsang ba dang mkha'/ hūm̐ dang hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rdo rje dang pad+ma nor bu dang ze'u 'brur/ oṃ dang āḥs byin gyis brlabs pa 'dus byas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad nas zhugs/

byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ 'khor lo bzhi yi lte bar babs/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon du mdzad/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo nas yum gyi rtsa kā ka mu kha'i sgor dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ rig pa'i stobs ldan sbyor ba'i mthus// 'khrul pa'i bag chags sprin gtor nas// ye shes nam mkha' gsal byed pa// gnyis med brtul zhugs chen po longs// e ka ya ma pra tīts+tsha hoḥ dngos dbang bskur ba'i skabs min na bla ma yab kyi byang sems dkar char mos su bcug pa'i thod chang sbyin/ bla mas de brjod slar gzungs mas// 'di ste khrag 'thung yab yum gyi// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga ldan pa'i ro rtogs byed// bde ba dam par myong bar gyis// skye gnas byang sems gnang ba ste/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ yang yum gyi dmar char mos nas thod chang sbyin/ mig dar 'grol/ de nas rang gi lce yis myong*/ rtog can sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa thams cad khyab/ skye gnas mthong bas lhag par bskul ba'i bde ba sgyu ma'i snang ba sna tshogs su gsal ba/ so so rang rig pa'i ngo bo nyid mngon du byed par gyur/ rak+ta gtor mar mchod pa'i tshig /dbang bskur 'don pa bsgyur la bskur// ces pas/ dwangs ma snying khrag bsgral ba shwa na'i khrag /mū la rten 'brel mkha' dbyings pad+ma'i khrag /dung chen snod du rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i rba// 'jigs pa'i lbu phreng chags pas dbang bskur ro// e ka ya ma gu h+ya rak+ta bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ zhes brjod nas rak+ta lag par gtad/ hūm̐/ phyi snod 'jig rten khams kyi snod chen por// nang bcud srid pa gsum las sbrus pa'i rdzas// 'byung lnga lhun grub dkar dmar snang bas brgyan// dpal gyi gtor ma chen pos dbang bskur ro// e ka ya ma ba ling dz+nyā na pū dza a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ zhes 'don pas dbang gtor mgor 'jog pa dkyil chog tu dngos bstan byung zhing*/

lcags 'dra dbang gi skabs tshor yang 'di kho na bzhin byung bas/ de ltar bskur dgos mod/ gzhan spyir btang gi dbang du na/ phrin las bstod pa'i shwa lo ka dang po'am/ lha yi rgyal po lha mchog gshin rje'i gshed// sogs 'don pa bsgyur nas/ lha dbang gi gtso tsaka bzhin bskur na yang*/ 'di nyid dbang gtor dngos gzhi yin pas mi 'thad pa med cing legs pa tsam du mngon/ 'on kyang sgrub dkyil rang gi dngos bstan ltar bya'o// thod phreng mgo la bkon nas su/ hūm̐/ thod pa tshar gsum phreng ba 'di// dug gsum sku gsum du bsgral nas// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// rgyal ba kun gyi dbang thob shog /mgo rlon ga shal byin nas su/ hūm̐/ khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i ga shal 'dis// sems byung ye shes su bsgral bas// khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang*// srid gsum zil gyis non gyur cig /thal chen tshom bu dpral bar btab/ hūm̐/ thal chen tshom bu 'di btab pas// thugs rje mtha' ru phyin pa'i dbang*// skye 'gro ma lus dbugs phyung nas// smin grol byed pa'i dbang thob shog /mkhur 'dzum sna rtser khrag chen bsku/ hūm̐/ rak+ta'i thig le 'di btab pas// thugs rje khyab pa'i dbang nyid de// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar// 'gro don byed pa'i dbang thob shog /snying gar rtse gsum zhag gis bris/ hūm̐/ zhag chen sor rigs 'di btab pas// dam rdzas bcud kyi dbang mchog ste// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis// skye 'chi med pa'i dbang thob shog /sbrul chen sked la bcings phyir sbyin/ hūm̐/ sbrul nag chun po'i ske rags 'di// zhe sdang rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// na rag dmyal ba bsgral ba'i phyir// zhe sdang dag pa'i dbang thob shog /glang chen ko rlon stod g.yogs su/ hūm̐/ glang chen ko rlon chen po 'di// theg pa chen po thob pa'i dbang*// ma lus de la gnas bya'i phyir// theg chen chos kyi dbang thob shog

/zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sked par dkris/ hūm̐/ zhing gi g.yang gzhi chen po 'dis/ gti mug rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// tir+ya ka ni bsgral bya'i phyir// gti mug dag pa'i dbang thob shog /stag gi sham thabs smad la dkris/ hūm̐/ stag lpags sham thabs chen po 'di// phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs pa'i dbang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag las bya'i phyir// thabs kyi don byed dbang thob shog /rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan byas la/ hūm̐/ rus pa'i rgyan drug chen po 'di// 'dod chags rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// pre ta ka ni bsgral ba'i phyir// 'dod chags dag pa'i dbang thob shog /tshe yi dbang ni 'di yin te/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gru gsum pa'i nang du nyi ma 'og dang*/ steng du zla ba kha sbyor ba'i gwa'u'i nang du tshe'i gzungs nṛ/ de'i gi gu/ na/ ra ta gsum las 'od dkar dmar mthing ga spros/ srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog thams cad bsdus/ de la thim/ 'od kyi thig le gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ bkra shis brtan pa'i gwa'u ru// mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe bskyil nas// rang rtags tshe yi dbang bskur bas// 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog /a+ye a+ye a+ye ya ma nṛ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas tshe gal spyi bor bzhag /tshe'i lha mo bdud rtsir zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs/ 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis lus dkar mer gyis gang ba'i mos pa gyis/ de nas tshogs kyi dbang bya ste/ hūm̐/ 'chi med bdud rtsi rā sa na// bkra shis mtshan ldan lhag pa'i rdzas// 'phel 'grib med pa'i dbang bskur bas// rigs lnga ye shes dbang thob shog /ces tshogs rdzas lag par gtad// 'chi ba med pa zhal zas kyi dbang bskur bas/ mi zad pa'i gter la longs spyod pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /'dir dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyi lus/ gang la bskur ba khyed rang rnams kyi ngag /dbang rdzas byang sems la sogs pa'i gsang dbang gi rdzas drug gis dbang bskur bas/

gsang ba'i dbang thob/ byed pa ngag gi sgrib pa dag /lam khyer rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob ste/ gsung gi phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// sher dbang gsol spro gnyis lan thig /dri lan gtad dbab slob sbyangs bskyed// snyoms 'jug don bstan de'i don bshad// ces pa'i dang po/ maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol gdab pa// zhes pa'i maṇ+ḍal skabs bla ma thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs zhing thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du zhes bton nas/ gsol gdab ni/ bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// mnyam pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol// dam tshig tshangs spyod sdom pa'i mchog /ye shes rol pa bdag la stsol// lan gsum/ gdong g.yogs nas ni gzungs ma la// bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i lhas// rig pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin byed la// gzungs ma yid 'ong spro bar gyis// des kyang spro zhes khas blangs pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas slob mar 'di skad brjod/ 'di 'dra'i dkyil 'khor bla na med// yang dag gsang ba'i lam mchaug ste// bu khyod skal pa rab tu gyur// 'di dang mjal la dga' ba bskyed// ces brjod pa'i lan du/ 'di'i rjes zlos byar bcug /bdag cag shin tu spro ba lags// dpa' bo chen po bka' drin che// zhes zhus las mkhan der 'ong nas// slob ma'i gnas lngar thig le bkod// e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// bha ga'i gnas la longs spyod dang*// gzugs ma mtshan ldan rtag tu brten// 'dod yon lnga la bde bar rol// gtsang dme ngo tsha'i rtog pa spongs// de ltar nus na brtul zhugs sbyin// bla ma'i tshig der lan slob mas// dpa' bo chen pos bka' stsal ltar// bdag ni de ltar rjes su 'jug

/slob ma'i lag g.yon gzungs mar gtad// gcer bu bha ga rgyas par bstan// dus gsum sangs rgyas byon pa'i gnas// bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas che// gnyis med cho gas snyoms zhugs nas// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byos/ khyed rang rnams 'od dpag med mdun gyi nam mkhar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba las/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad 'od kyis dmar lam lam gyur pa'i mos pa gyis/ zhes brjod rol sgra spos kyis bdug /me long la has btab pa ltar 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i sku de je phra je phrar gyur te stong pa nyid du yal ba las/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i sku/ gzungs ma rdo rje khros mar gsal ba rjes chags kyi sbyor bas bskul ba'i nang gi byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang zhing dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon tu byas pas/ yum gyi bha ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams mchod de/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po'i ngo bor mnyes nas byang chub kyi sems thig ler zhu ba/ dung can gyi nang nas gyen du gshegs pa'i rim gyis phung po khams skye mched kyi snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes kyi lha'i rol mor sad pa'i mos pa gyis/ 'di ni gsang ba'i theg mchog ste// ye shes bla na med pa'i don// rang byung ye shes 'di las thob// 'di las mchog tu gzhan med do// sbyor du bcug nas de brjod do// mig dar bkrol/ 'dir dkyil 'khor shes rab ma'i bha ga /gang la bskur na khyed rang rnams kyi yid la/ tshul ji ltar bskur na/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i rdzas dbang bskur bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ byed pa yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam khyer pho nya sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob ste/ thugs kyi phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// baṃ dbang la ni rjes gnang gsol// bskyed bskur rgyas btab bsgral bas blangs// ngo sprad gzengs bstod dbugs phyung la// zhes pa'i dang po// rjes su gnang phyir slob dpon gyis// hi hi zhes pa'i bzhad sgra yis// steng 'og phyogs mtshams ci snang ba// thams cad dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// ma lus kun gyi nang na yang*// bla med zil gnon rngam pa'i sku// gnyis med rol pa'i cha lugs kyi// bde chen lha yi nga ro 'byung*// mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin par bya'o// de nas/

bla ma ngo bo nyid sku'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs shing*/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob ma rab dga' gus pa'i phyag /na mo/ che ba'i nang nas che ba'i mchog /phyag 'tshal phyag rgya zil gnon la'o// mnyam nyid brtul zhugs chen po yi// baṃ chen rtog med bde chen gang*// da lta nyid du ci nus phob// e ma hoḥngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'di 'dra'i theg chen bla na med// brtul zhugs da lta nyid du phob/ hūm̐ mūm̐/ rigs kyi bu khyed rang rnams 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lhar skad cig gis gsal ba'i dam tshig sems dpar/ baṃ chen gyi snying ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs kyi ye shes sems dpa' thams cad chil chil thim pas gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ngo bo gcig tu gyur pas ye shes bla na med pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis/ rol sgra spos ngad chi li li/ a+ye ring dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥsngags// lan gsum bzlas la rdo rje'i rtses/ dri yi thig les gnas gsum brgyan/ kā wāka tsi sngags sngar bzhin brjod// drag pos bsgral phyir ral gri gtad// hūm̐/ gshed chen mthu stobs yongs rdzogs las// dpag med phrin las mthar phyin zhing*// stong pa srid pa zil mnan nas// snang srid sku sprul dbang bskur ro// e ka he dun ya ma kro dha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ baṃ ro dum bur gtubs spungs khar// chang gi kab li bzhag nas su// bdud rtsi bzhin du byin gyis brlabs// zhes pas/ thod dbus rigs lnga snyoms zhugs bdud rtsir zhu// nyi bkab rta mgrin sbyor mtshams byang sems phab// bdag gi mtheb mdzub zla bas zag dang 'dres// mdangs dri ro bcud gter chen dpa' bos bsrungs// oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥswāhā/

mūm̐ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ oṃ āḥsarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ thams cad bdud rtsir skya mer zhu// de yis dbang bskur byin nas 'thung*// a ho/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad kyi thabs// 'chi med rang byung bdud rtsi'i gter// longs spyod dag pas dbang bskur bas// thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /baṃ chen maṃ sas dbang bskur sbyin// hūm̐/ mnyam pa nyid kyi brtul zhugs kyis// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med par// ma 'gag ye shes rtsal shar bas// baṃ chen dme ba don dang sbyar// brtul zhugs sngags kyi byin rlabs bskyed// baṃ chen ro la mnyam par sbyor// rdo rje brjid pa'i dbang thob nas// bde chen mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /e ka ya ma a ti pa ti ti ra sid+dhi hoḥ gtsang dme'i rtog pa med par mnyam nyid chen po'i ngang du rol bas/ lus thams cad zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis skya mer gyis gang bas bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog gi skal pa can du 'gyur ba'o// zhes brjod chang dang sha la rol/ rang sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag pas chos nyid skye ba med pa kun bzang bde chen yangs pa'i klong na 'khor 'das 'dam ka med pa/ mnyam nyid chen por khyab gdal ba chos kyi sku/ da lta rang gi rig pa 'di kho na dbang bzhi pa yin no// 'dir dkyil 'khor rang byung gi ye shes chos nyid khyab gdal chen po/ de yang baṃ gyi rnam par mtshon te/ baṃ la rtog pa skad cig kyang med pa bzhin/ skye mched thams cad bkra lam mer snang ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin/ don rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos nyid yin pas so// gang la bskur na khyed rang rnams kyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes la/ ji ltar bskur na rnam par mi rtog pa'i rdzas gyis bskur bas/ dbang bzhi pa yang dag pa'i chos nyid mi rtog pa'i ye shes su thob/ byed pa shes sgrib dag /lam khyer phyag rgya chen po de kho na nyid bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid rdo rje'i sku thob ste/

phrin las thams cad kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// rigs kyi bu khyed rnams de lta bu'i don dang ldan pas rgyud yongs su smin pa yin no// zhes pas gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung ba// de ltar dbang bzhi thob nas dam tshig ma nyams par/ lam bsnyen sgrub rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bsgrub na brtson 'grus can tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya bas/ dman pa nyan rang ltar bskal pa grangs med du dka' ba spyad mi dgos te/ lam mchog chen po'i skal bas dge ba yin no// slob dpon mthu dang thun dang zor// zhes rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po/ de nas slob dpon byed pa'i phyir// gdugs phub sogs khrir slob ma bkod// 'khor lo rkang 'og dung 'bud cing*// 'di rgyud po ti gtad nas su// phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// khyed kyi dbang rnams rdzogs par thob// da ni khyod kyis slob dpon gyis// slob ma smin cing grol bar mdzod/ oṃ e ka ya ma gu ru a bhi ṣiñca sid+dhi hūm̐/ de nas mthu yi dbang ni/ brub khung thod nang lid+ga bcug /phur bu gdab cing mtshon gyis gtubs/ zhes gsungs pa/ spros bcas 'chams sogs dang 'brel ba'i sgrub dbang gi skabs yin na/ las byang gzhung gi bsgral las bstab pa dang bcas pa byas kyang 'gal ba med cing legs pa yin la/ gzhan brub khung bskyed chog bya/ bden pa bdar ba dang bcas pa'i dgug gzhug tshar gsum nas/ thugs rje thabs kyi sbyor ba sogs kyis phur ba gdab/ rdo rje 'khor lo dbyug thog mtshon cha brdog cing gtubs nas/ hūm̐/ gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs la// snying rje ma rung sems kyis ni// phrin las drag pos bsgral ba'i phyir// mngon spyod mthu yi dbang bskur ro// dgra bo mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes pas phur pa lid+ga dang sbrags pa slob ma'i lag tu gtad de dbang bskur/ slar yang lid+ga slob ma'i gtso bo'i mdun du bkod nas thun gyi dbang ni/

g.yas thun g.yon du rak+sha'i phreng*// hūm̐/ drag po sngags kyi dbang thob nas// dgra bgegs gdug pa 'joms pa'i phyir// gzi byin bskyed pa'i thun dang ni// bgrang phreng rak+sha'i dbang bskur ro// thun sngags a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pa'i thun sngags ni/ e ka he dun traka rak+sha ya/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya/ dgra bo e myag ya rngubs muka shak+ka dun bh+yo nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pa dbang bskur nas/ rgyas par spro na/ thun so so'i tshigs bcad las byang ltar len pas sam/ bsdu na thun sngags de kho nas thun yongs rdzogs slob mas nya'u la brdeg tu bcug /zor dbang ni/ zor rdzas gtad nas 'di skad do// hūm̐/ thabs shes nus pa mthar phyin nas// byad ma rdul du brlag pa la// nga rgyal chen pos 'phen byed pa'i// zor rdzas rnams kyi dbang thob shog /zor sngags mthar ni a bhi sogs// zhes pas/ e ka he dun bh+yo bzlog /ya ma rā dza bh+yo bzlog /ma mo e ka dza ṭi thun bh+yo bzlog /mā rā ya bzlog /ma mo e ka tsa ti thun bh+yo bzlog /phu sa na ga gtad khraṃ bh+yo bzlog /phyung phyung shig shig /khrol khrol mā rā ya s+t+wam+bha ya laṃ nan/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ 'ur rdo sogs zor rdzas tshang ma gtad/ dmar gtor ni nges par dgos pa'i yan lag rang min/ byas kyang mi rung ba ni med/ yod phyin skabs 'dir 'phen du gzhug dgos// de nas rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob kyis/ deng phyin chad bskyed rdzogs bsnyen sgrub legs par gyis la/ 'di'i sgo nas dbang dang byin rlabs dang*/ 'chad nyan dang gdug pa can la drag po'i phrin las la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzod cig /ces brjod/ slob mas 'di skad zhu/ dpa' bo chen po'i bka' bzhin du// sems can don la brtson par bgyi/

zhes pas lan gsum rjes zlos byar bcug /slar yang lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po thams cad lha dang*/ bla ma la 'bul gyi cha shas nas kyang longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol// lan gsum/ bla ma'i sku chu lha tshogs der// nya ldang 'dra bsam yon phul la// zhes pas/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal po'i sku skad cig gis chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du/ 'jam dpal zil gnon chen po'i lha tshogs su bzhengs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ ces gdams/ tshogs la rol nas slob ma rnams gyes su bcug /las kyi rjes skabs dang bstun te bsdu bar bya/ slob dpon gyis lhag gtor btang*/ chad mdo bsgrags/ lha tshogs rnams bskul nas/ sgo dbye lam bstan dang bcas/ 'bru nag gi gtor chen lcags sdig gtor bzlog skabs kyi lag len bzhin 'phang nas bstan skyong gtor bro'i bar dang*/ rjes chog lhag chad kha bskang*/ brtan bzhugs shis brjod dge bsngo sogs bya// nyin phyi mar skyabs sems nas bzung las byang gzhung bzhin btang*/ bsnyen pa ci nus bya/ tshogs las chad mdo bstan skyong gi bar du sgrub nas/ sgrub rdzogs rdzas kyi dngos grub blangs// lus bsrung rdul tshon chu bor dor// ces gsungs pa'i dang po dngos grub len pa la rdzas bsham pa/ bgegs bskrad pa/ byin 'bebs pa/ dngos grub bsdu ba/ dngos grub bskul ba/ dngos grub len pa/ mthar smon lam gdab pa ste rnam pa bdun las/ dang po la/ dngos grub kyi rdzas 'brang rgyas dang*/ sha zan tshe gal sogs sngar nas bshams zin pa dang*/ gzhan yang tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ mar/ 'khur ba/ thud/ 'ol gon/ 'bras/ zho/ bu ram/

la du/ shing thog sogs bza' btung gi bye brag sna tshogs pa bshams nas/ rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i sgrub pa po rnams dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtha' bskor du 'khod bzhin pas/ gnyis pa/ bgegs bskrod pa dang gsum pa byin 'bebs pa gnyis las byang ltar byas rjes/ bzhi pa dngos grub bsdu ba ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi dkyil la oṃ dkar po'i mthar e ka ya ma he dun sogs sku'i snying pos bskor ba/ sbyor yum gyi thugs kar dzaḥrang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sbyor yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥl phog /de las 'od 'phros yab kyi sa bon la phog thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas thim pa'i mos pas/ sku'i snying po la kā ya badz+ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ btags pa ci mang bzla/ de bzhin du gsung thugs yon tan phrin las la'ang rigs bsgres te sbyar/ de yang yab kyi thugs kar sa bon ā hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥrnams kha dog dmar mthing ser ljang rang 'od 'phro ba sngags/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag /a+ye myags ya rngubs/ a+ye thung*/ a+ye ring*/ byin rlabs bsdu rgyu gsung*/ thugs/ yon tan/ phrin las kyi byin bcud bsdus nas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags bcas dang*/ gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs bdag dang rten rdzas dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams la thim par mos pas/ so sor bsnyen pa yang ci rigs pa bzla/ phrin las drag po'i skabs thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang sngags phreng las 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros pas gdon bgegs gnod byed dregs pa can rnams bsad gtubs thal bar btang nas de dag gi tshe bsod dbang thang klung rta dang*/ ye shes lha'i byin rlabs chabs cig tu 'dus thim/

drag po'i las kyi dngos grub thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa bya/ tshe bum dang tshe rdzas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zil gnon lha// dmar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum can// thugs kar nṛ las a+ye ring gsum// drag bzlas 'od kyis snod bcud bzhus// tshe lhar 'dus pas tshe yi lhas// nṛ la dbang bskur bh+rūm̐ gyis srung*// hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i drwa mig bsdams// a+ye a+ye a+ye ya ma nṛ bhūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ btags pa brgya rtsa bzlas/ brtan g.yo 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi tshe srog bsod nams dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad tshe'i rang bzhin du bsdus nas thim par mos/ phyi snod nang bcud thams cad sems// 'jig rten dregs pa yab yum thim// yab yum sngags bcas hūm̐ la bsdu// hūm̐ bcas dngos grub rdzas la bsdu// rang gi lus ngag yid la thim// zhes brjod/ lnga pa dngos grub bskul ba ni/ hoḥ nam mkha'i khams mnyam zil gnon 'jam pa'i dbyangs// sku yi dngos grub nam mkha'i dkyil yangs bzhin// gsung gi dngos grub 'gag med brjod dang bral// thugs kyi dngos grub mi rtog mnyam pa'i ngang*// yon tan dngos grub yid bzhin rin chen gter// phrin las dngos grub rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dngos grub rnam lnga'i dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor// ji ltar bsam pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// gnas skabs nad gdon bar chad la sogs pa// mi mthun gnon pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang*// mnga' thang snyan grags dgos dgu rgyas pa dang*// mos bzhi khams gsum srid gsum lha mi'i nor// yid la gang 'dod dbang du 'du ba dang*// bstan dang bla mar do brdo bdag la 'tshe// dgra bgegs gang byung drag pos bsgral ba sogs// rnam bzhi'i las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// mthar thug bdag don phun tshogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs// ye shes sems pa'i go 'phang myur thob cing*// gzhan don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams// gang la gang 'dul gzugs sku'i chos bstan nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la rab 'god pa'i// don gnyis phun tshogs dngos grub deng stsol cig

/hūm̐/ yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bdag nyid rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// dzb bsnyen grangs su thems zin gyis// bskyed rdzogs drod tshad thob zin gyis// thugs dam gnyan po bskang zin gyis// bsgrub pa'i zhag grangs tshang zin gyis// rdo rje srin po'i nam langs nye// dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab// dam can thugs dam bdag bskul gyis// sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam dang*// dam bca' ma bsnyel deng dgongs la// dngos grub dam pa da lta stsol// lan gsum brjod// de nas dngos grub len pa ni// sgrub po rnams dngos grub kyi rdzas lag tu thogs nas/ dpral bar gtug ste/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i tshul ston khro bo'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /sku yi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// gdos bcas lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ mgrin par gtug la/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /gsung gi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// 'chal ba ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ snying gar gtug la/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i= 'dir gshegs= thugs kyi dbang= 'khrul pa sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ gnas gsum du gtug la/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i= 'dir gshegs= rnam gsum dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// dug gsum nad gdon sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ las byang gzhung bzhin byin brlabs nas// mtheb srin gyis 'thor bzhin du/ phyag rgya zil gnon 'jam dpal gshin rje dang*// shrī singha paṇa chen zhi ba'i zhabs// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi// rgyal po nor 'dzin gnubs chen rdo rje 'chang*// gter ston zhang khrom dharma kīrti dpal// sman mchod=

sarba pañca= gnubs ston bya bral skal ldan rdo rje rgyal// chos kyi rgyal mtshan gu ru mchog ldan la// sman mchod= sarba= rgyal mtshan lhun grub tshe bdag bkra shis dang*// kun mkhyen pad dkar mchog gzigs lha rtse'i zhabs// sman mchod= sarba= dpag bsam dbang po yongs 'dzin kun dga'i mtshan// chos kyi dbang phyug chos rgyal dpal bzang por// sman mchod= sarba= chos kyi rgyal po phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal// drin chen bla ma ngag dbang bde chen la// sman mchod= sarba= gzhan yang bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// 'jam dpal zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// sman= sarba= dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gter srung dang*// gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong rnams la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ zhes phul nas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad bdag cag dpon slob rnams la da lta nyid du stsal nas/ sku lnga ye shes lnga'i yon tan ma lus pa rtsol ba med par lhun gyis grub par gyur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas dngos grub gnang bar bsams nas/ rdzas rnams la rol lo// bdun pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ 'di ltar bsags pa'i legs byas mthus// bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad dang*// khyad par 'jam dpal zhi khro yis// tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin shog /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa sogs brjod// gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas nas/ yig brgya ci mang brjod/ gnyis pa lus bsrung ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid 'jam dpal zil gnon du lus dkyil mngon rtogs bzhin sgom nas/ cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs pa'i// stong pa'i go cha bla na med// mtshan ma'i yul kun bcom nas ni// thams cad du ni rgyas par gnas// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi phyag rgyas bka' nan byas pas/

lus thams cad rdo rje rgya gram gyi go chas gtams par bsam zhing*/ lus bsrung dngos ni 'di skad do// ming dang mtshan ma ma grub pas// mi gnas mi 'bral 'dus ma byas// chos kyi dbyings kyi bsrung ba na// sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs so// oṃ rak+ṣa maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas phyi rol tu song la/ rgyal po sde bzhi dang*/ sgo byang la bskyed pa'i khro bo gnyis dang bcas par mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams sngar sta gon gyi skabs bzhin du byas la/ ye shes pa byang bu la brtan bzhugs bya ba'am/ yang na gshegs gsol byas te byang bu rnams bkrol/ nang du 'ong nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtha' skor du sgrub pa po mched lcam rnams phan tshun lag bsnol mar mar me re 'dzin bzhin du 'khod la/ ston pa rdo rje rgyal pos/ dbyangs snyan po dang bcas te drangs pa'i rjes zlos gzhan dag gis kyang byas te gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas smon lam 'di ltar gdab bo/ hūm̐ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// snying po byang chub lam la zhugs pa yis// 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing*// chags sdang gcong rong gnas su mi skye dang*// log lta dmyal ba'i zangs khar rbab mi 'gril// 'khon 'dzing gcan gzan gdug pa'i skad mi thos// nyon mongs mtshon rtse gdug pa'i zer mi phog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin che ba dang*// srog gis sbrel ba'i mched dang lcam dral dang*// gsum pa'i dbang gis sbrel ba'i rig ma gsum// skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du// mi 'bral skad cig 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// sa bcu khyad par rim gyis bgrod par shog /nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brje'i dus byung nas// 'khor ba'i g.yang sar lan gcig ltung srid kyang*// snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs gsal 'dis// rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cing*// kun tu 'od kyi sa la rgyud sbyangs nas// pad+ma chen po'i sa la lhun gyis grub// 'khor lo tshogs chen sa la gshegs pa'i tshe// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis mdun bsus shig

/yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog brtan cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sna drongs shig /ma tshogs dbang mo rnams kyis rjes skyongs shig /lcang lo can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe// mi ldog pa yi sa la gnas nas kyang*// zil gnon khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal mthong nas// rig 'dzin rnams dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang*// bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog /de nas dkyil 'khor mtha'i khro bcu'i phur pa ma gtogs/ gzhan dkyil 'khor dbus kyi sgrub rdzas sku gsung thugs rten dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan bkod thams cad bsdus nas/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ya uta kī la ya sarba kī la ya badz+ra dhā rota adz+nyā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags bzla zhing*/ rkang pa g.yon brkyang dang*/ lag pa skam pa'i rgyas phur bu rnams dang por gdab rim las go ldog tu phyungs te/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur rtse bkru zhing phur khung la'ang gtor/ de nas dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na/ 'dir gzugs sogs kyis brtan zhugs byas la me tog 'thor nas bsdu/ rdul tshon yin na slob dpon gyis a kā ro'i sngags bzla bzhin du phyag mtshan rdo rjes/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas brtsams te lte ba'i bar bskor bas re khā gsum 'then cing lha mtshan nas cung zad blangs pa mgo bor bkod/ lhag ma 'phyag pa snod du blug /dri bzang gi chus thig rnams kyang mtha' nas rim bzhin bsrub la/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan/ gsum pa rdul tshon chu bor 'dor ba'ang dkyil chog spyi ltar shes par bya'o// thos pa nyung zhing sbyangs pa'i mthu chung ba// kho bo blo gros phye ma leb lta bu// pad gnubs dgongs pa nam mkha'i pha mtha' dang*// kun mkhyen che de'i gsung gsang rgya mtsho'i dkyel// gzhal ba'i mthu ko tshad mas ci ste dmigs// de lta mod kyi dus gsum rgyal bas kyang*// bskrun du med pa'i bka' drin mdzad pa po// bla ma mchog gi bka' stsal bdag rjes bsgrub// 'di la rmongs pas bslad pa'i 'khrul bgyis gang*// bla ma lhar bcas mgon po'i spyan sngar 'chags// dang po'i las can byis pa mi mkhas pa// rang dang skal mnyam tshegs med 'jug bde zhing*// lag len gsal byed dran pa'i gsos thebs phyir// brjed byang tsam du 'gyur ba 'di'i dgos pa// khyad par bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i dges// 'gro tshogs 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sa thob shog

ces pa 'di'ang bka' drin mtshungs med 'khor lo'i mgon po/ 7 skyabs mgon yongs su 'dzin pa chen po mi pham 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i zhabs pad nas 'di bzhin 'phral du sbyor zhig ces bka' stsal spyi bor phebs pa bzhin/ bka' 'bangs pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas dpal phun tshogs chos 'khor gling gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar bas sems can thams cad bla med sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
